items.title: 伊朗總統：是否結束戰爭由美國決定 「我們不希望繼續」
items.title_en: Iranian President: Ending the War Depends on the United States "We Do Not Want to Continue"
paras: 伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚(Masoud Pezeshkian)表示，是否結束持續近7個月的伊朗戰爭，取決於美國是否願意停止這場衝突。他在接受美國福斯新聞(Fox News)節目「Special Report with Bret Baier」訪問時表示，伊朗並不希望戰爭繼續，但最終選擇權在美國。
佩澤希齊揚說：「但我們不希望繼續下去。美國必須選擇，它是否想要結束這場戰爭。」當被問及這場衝突是否可能在今年底前結束時，他作出上述回應。
佩澤希齊揚此前在9月23日出席聯合國大會時表示，伊朗不會向美國壓力屈服，並強調德黑蘭仍願意透過外交途徑解決衝突，但雙方目前在結束戰爭的條件上仍存在重大分歧。
美國總統川普則在9月22日表示，如果無法達成結束戰爭的協議，美國可以「消滅」伊朗，但同時也暗示雙方可能很快達成協議。川普對戰爭目標與時間表的說法近期有所變化，而這場戰事始於2月28日，當時美國與以色列對伊朗發動攻擊，伊朗隨後對以色列以及境內駐有美軍基地的海灣國家發動反擊。
美以對伊朗的攻擊以及以色列在黎巴嫩的軍事行動，已造成數千人死亡、數百萬人流離失所。川普則將削弱伊朗核能力列為戰爭目標之一。伊朗並未擁有核武器，也否認尋求核武，並主張身為核不擴散條約(NPT)締約國，伊朗有權發展和平用途的核技術。美國則是核武國家。
與此同時，美伊雙方正在紐約透過間接談判尋求外交出口。路透社引述熟悉談判的伊朗、區域及西方外交人士指出，雙方正在討論分階段安排，其中核心內容包括伊朗重新開放荷姆茲海峽，以及美國解除對伊朗的經濟封鎖。荷姆茲海峽已成為此次談判的主要籌碼，伊朗希望解除封鎖，美國則要求恢復全球重要能源航道的自由通行。
一名伊朗高級官員表示，較可行的方式是分階段解決危機，第一階段包括解除封鎖並重新開放荷姆茲海峽，伊朗也可能因此取得遭凍結資產的部分使用權。不過，雙方仍面臨誰應先讓步的問題，過去7月達成的臨時諒解已經破裂，因此目前談判不只要處理協議內容，也必須設法建立足夠持久的安排，讓雙方相信對方會履行承諾。
荷姆茲海峽是全球重要能源運輸通道，伊朗方面已透過中間人向美國提出重新開放的條件。佩澤希齊揚在聯合國演說中也表示，不能讓其他國家都從荷姆茲海峽獲益，卻禁止伊朗利用這條水道進行航運，並警告敵對軍力長期部署與戰爭擴大無助於實現和平。
談判同時受到美國制裁與經濟封鎖的影響。美國近期進一步鎖定伊朗航空公司及相關支援網路，試圖切斷支撐伊朗政府與伊斯蘭革命衛隊的經濟來源。伊朗經濟則面臨物價上升、貿易受阻與家庭收入承壓等問題，使持續戰爭帶來的經濟成本進一步升高。
另一方面，荷姆茲海峽局勢也持續牽動國際能源市場。布蘭特原油在9月24日下跌94美分或0.9%, 報每桶102.13美元; 美國西德州中級原油(WTI)下跌59美分或0.7%, 報每桶91.56美元。油價在前一交易日曾大漲約4%, 市場持續評估美伊外交是否可能降低供應中斷風險。
美國與伊朗能否將荷姆茲海峽重新開放、解除經濟封鎖以及核問題納入同一套可執行安排，仍是談判能否取得突破的關鍵。伊朗總統最新表態顯示，德黑蘭公開立場仍是願意透過外交結束戰爭，但拒絕在美國持續施壓的情況下單方面讓步; 華府則仍將經濟與軍事壓力作為迫使伊朗接受協議的主要手段。
paras_en: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said that whether the nearly seven‑month‑long war involving Iran ends depends on whether the United States is willing to halt the conflict. In an interview with Fox News’ program “Special Report with Bret Baier,” he stated that Iran does not want the war to continue, but the final decision lies with the United States.

Pezeshkian added, "But we do not want to continue. The United States must choose whether it wants to end this war." He gave this response when asked if the conflict could be resolved before the end of the year.

Pezeshkian previously told the United Nations General Assembly on September 23 that Iran would not bow to U.S. pressure and emphasized that Tehran remains willing to resolve the conflict diplomatically, although both sides still have major disagreements over the conditions for ending the war.

U.S. President Trump said on September 22 that if an agreement to end the war cannot be reached, the United States could "eliminate" Iran, while also hinting that a deal might be reached soon. Trump’s statements on the war’s objectives and timeline have recently shifted, and the fighting began on February 28 when the United States and Israel launched attacks on Iran, prompting Iranian retaliation against Israel and U.S. bases in Gulf states.

The U.S.–Israel attacks on Iran and Israel’s military actions in Lebanon have caused thousands of deaths and displaced millions. Trump has listed weakening Iran’s nuclear capability as one of the war’s goals. Iran does not possess nuclear weapons, denies seeking them, and argues that as a signatory to the Nuclear Non‑Proliferation Treaty it has the right to develop nuclear technology for peaceful purposes. The United States, by contrast, is a nuclear‑armed state.

Meanwhile, the United States and Iran are conducting indirect talks in New York to seek a diplomatic exit. Reuters, citing Iranian, regional and Western diplomats familiar with the negotiations, said the parties are discussing a phased arrangement that includes, at its core, Iran reopening the Strait of Hormuz and the United States lifting its economic sanctions on Iran. The Strait of Hormuz has become the main bargaining chip, with Iran seeking to end the blockade and the United States demanding the restoration of free passage through this vital global energy route.

A senior Iranian official said a more feasible approach is a step‑by‑step resolution, with the first phase involving lifting the blockade and reopening the Strait of Hormuz, which could also allow Iran limited use of assets that were frozen. However, the parties still dispute who should make the first concession; the temporary understanding reached in July has already collapsed, so negotiations now must not only address the agreement’s content but also create a durable framework that convinces both sides they will honor their commitments.

The Strait of Hormuz is a critical global energy corridor, and Iran has conveyed reopening conditions to the United States through intermediaries. In his UN speech, Pezeshkian warned that it is unacceptable for other countries to benefit from the strait while Iran is barred from using it for shipping, and cautioned that long‑term deployment of hostile forces and an expanding war do not help achieve peace.

The talks are also affected by U.S. sanctions and the economic blockade. The United States has recently targeted Iranian airlines and related support networks in an effort to cut off financial sources for the Iranian government and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. Iran’s economy is facing rising prices, trade disruptions and pressure on household incomes, which further raises the economic cost of the ongoing war.

On the other hand, the Hormuz situation continues to sway international energy markets. Brent crude fell 94 cents, or 0.9%, on September 24 to $102.13 a barrel, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate dropped 59 cents, or 0.7%, to $91.56 a barrel. Prices had surged about 4% the previous trading day as markets kept assessing whether U.S.–Iran diplomacy might reduce the risk of supply disruptions.

Whether the United States and Iran can jointly reopen the Strait of Hormuz, lift the economic blockade and incorporate the nuclear issue into a single executable framework remains the key to any breakthrough. The president’s latest remarks show Tehran’s public stance is still to end the war through diplomacy, but it will not make unilateral concessions while U.S. pressure persists; Washington, meanwhile, continues to use economic and military pressure as its main lever to compel Iran to accept an agreement.

items.title: 彭博：川普政府擬推海外美元穩定幣計畫 鞏固美元全球地位
items.title_en: Bloomberg: Trump Administration Plans Overseas Dollar‑Backed Stablecoin to Cement Global Dollar Dominance
paras: 知情人士透露，川普政府正在考慮一項旨在推廣在海外使用美元計價穩定幣的計畫，以鞏固美元的全球儲備資產地位。
據《彭博》24日（周四）報導，消息人士表示，穩定幣項目是美國政府考慮通過與私營企業組建合資企業來支持的領域。
該項目可能涉及多個聯邦機關，包括財政部和國務院。另有知情人士指出，美國國際開發金融公司（DFC）也可能參與其中。
DFC通常與私營部門實體合作，以推進美國外交政策目標，該機構由阿波羅全球管理公司（Apollo Global Management）共同創始人Leon Black之子Ben Black負責監管。
穩定幣是一種通常與傳統貨幣掛鉤的數位資產；隨著金融機構採用此類資產，其受歡迎程度日益提高，且目前流通的絕大多數穩定幣都與美元掛鉤。
去年美國總統川普簽署的《GENIUS法案》，確立了針對穩定幣的聯邦監管框架，要求發行方持有美元、短期國債等儲備資產。
美國財政部部長貝森特也曾表示，穩定幣的發展有望增強美元作為全球儲備貨幣的作用。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Insiders say the Trump administration is weighing a plan to promote the use of dollar‑denominated stablecoins abroad, aiming to reinforce the dollar’s status as the world’s reserve asset.
According to Bloomberg on Thursday the 24th, sources said the stablecoin initiative is an area the U.S. government is considering supporting through joint ventures with private firms.

The project could involve multiple federal agencies, including the Treasury and State Departments, and another source noted that the U.S. International Development Finance Corporation (DFC) may also take part.
The DFC typically partners with private‑sector entities to advance U.S. foreign‑policy goals, and the agency is overseen by Ben Black, son of Apollo Global Management co‑founder Leon Black.

A stablecoin is a digital asset usually pegged to a traditional currency; as financial institutions adopt such assets, their popularity is rising, and the vast majority of stablecoins in circulation are dollar‑pegged.
Last year President Trump signed the GENIUS Act, establishing a federal regulatory framework for stablecoins that requires issuers to hold reserves such as dollars and short‑term Treasury securities.
U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen has also said that the development of stablecoins could strengthen the dollar’s role as the global reserve currency.

items.title: 「搶配額」大戰落幕！經部落槌：輸歐鋼品總額分3次開放、自由配額減半
items.title_en: "Quota Battle" Ends! Ministry of Economic Affairs Strikes: EU Steel Export Quota Split into Three Rounds, Free Quota Halved
paras: 對近期鋼鐵業者高度關注的我國金屬塗層鋼板（輸歐鋼品第4A類別）出口歐盟管理措施，經濟部昨（24）日緊急邀集代表性鋼鐵業者、貿易商及鋼鐵公會等各方代表，展開長達5小時的跨部會與產業深度研商。經濟部今（25）日正式對外宣布，雙方已達成重大共識，決定將「自由申請配額」占比由原本的20%調降至10%，且總額將平均分三次開放申請，有效避免開開放即被一搶而空的亂象，全力維護我國鋼鐵外銷秩序。

因應歐盟關稅防衛 經濟部跨部會共識敲定

經濟部說明，歐盟自2019年起對進口鋼鐵實施關稅配額防衛措施，並給予台灣特定的國家配額。為維持鋼品輸歐秩序，政府與鋼鐵公會及業界共同研擬出配額機制，將國家配額劃分為「出口實績」與「自由申請配額」兩大類。若業界無特別共識，先前預設自由配額占比為20%。
隨著歐盟鋼鐵防衛措施於今（2026）年6月底屆期，歐盟自7月1日起繼續以關稅配額方式管制鋼品輸入，並新增金屬塗層鋼板的國家配額。為協助國內業者穩健拓展歐盟市場，經濟部比照先前機制公告相關規範，並續由鋼鐵公會辦理受理、審查與分配作業。

審查機制透明化 配額改分三次申請避免秒殺

鋼鐵公會於會中強調，針對4A類別的「自由申請配額」，公會始終秉持公平公正原則，嚴格落實資格審查與合約規範，並依據合格總申請量的比例公開計算與登錄分配，確保各家業者權益。
為了解決業者反映「剛開放申請配額就被搶光」的痛點，會中經充分溝通後達成兩項關鍵調整：
配額比例調降： 金屬塗層鋼板的「自由申請配額」占比由20%調降至10%，擴大實績業者的穩定配額。
分階段開放申請： 自由配額總額將採取平均分三次申請的方式發放，防範短時間內配額耗盡。
經濟部強調，政府高度重視鋼鐵業者的出口利益，未來將因應國際經貿情勢變化，持續與業界保持密切溝通，並滾動式檢討各類輸歐鋼品的分配機制，協助台灣鋼鐵產業在國際市場立於不敗之地。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs held an emergency five‑hour inter‑agency and industry round‑table yesterday (the 24th) to discuss Taiwan’s metal‑coated steel sheet (Category 4A steel exports to the EU), which has drawn intense attention from the steel sector. The ministry announced today (the 25th) that a major consensus has been reached: the share of “free‑application quota” will be cut from the original 20% to 10%, and the total amount will be released in three equal batches, preventing the chaos of the quota being snapped up instantly and fully safeguarding Taiwan’s steel export order.

The ministry explained that the EU has applied anti‑dumping tariff‑quota safeguards on imported steel since 2019 and granted Taiwan a specific national quota. To maintain orderly steel exports to the EU, the government, together with the steel association and industry, devised a quota mechanism that divides the national quota into “export‑performance quota” and “free‑application quota.” In the absence of a specific industry agreement, the free quota was previously set at 20%.

As the EU’s steel defence measures expire at the end of June 2026, the EU will continue to regulate steel imports via tariff‑quota from July 1 and has added a national quota for metal‑coated steel sheets. To help domestic firms steadily expand into the EU market, the Ministry of Economic Affairs announced the relevant rules based on the previous mechanism and will continue to have the Steel Association handle applications, reviews and allocations.

The Steel Association emphasized during the meeting that for the 4A “free‑application quota,” it will always uphold fairness and impartiality, strictly enforce eligibility checks and contract standards, and publicly calculate and record allocations based on the proportion of qualified total applications, ensuring the rights of all firms.
To address industry complaints that “the quota is snatched up as soon as it opens,” the meeting, after thorough discussion, agreed on two key adjustments:
Quota share reduction: the “free‑application quota” for metal‑coated steel sheets will be lowered from 20% to 10%, expanding stable allocations for firms with proven export performance.
Staged application: the total free quota will be distributed in three equal rounds, preventing the quota from being exhausted in a short period.

The ministry stressed that the government places great importance on the export interests of steel companies and will, in response to changing international trade conditions, maintain close communication with the industry and continuously review the allocation mechanisms for all EU‑bound steel products, helping Taiwan’s steel sector remain competitive in the global market.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉PCB擺脫鬼故事！台日供應鏈點火 009828周漲逾7%重返發行價
items.title_en: Hot Stock: PCB Breaks the Ghost Story! Taiwan-Japan Supply Chain Ignites, 009828 Gains Over 7% This Week, Returns to Issue Price
paras: 日本股市在結束三天假期後於 24 日恢復交易，吸引資金顯著回補；同時，台股 CCL 族群擺脫先前「降級鬼故事」陰霾，激勵整體 PCB 類股近期連袂上揚。在台日兩地供應鏈齊揚的帶動下，中信台日韓 PCB(009828-TW)展現強勁反彈力道，24 日股價順利站回 10 元發行價，終場上漲 1.73% 收在 10.02 元，單周累計漲幅達 7.28%。整體交投表現持續增溫，反映市場資金關注重心再度強勢回歸。
009828於9月初掛牌，隨即遭遇市場利空，多處於破發狀況，但本周展開強勁反彈，主要歸功於台日兩地 AI 供應鏈的共振效應，日股方面，受惠AI伺服器與高效能運算(HPC)需求，全球IC載板龍頭Ibiden(揖斐電)盤中一度暴漲逾15%，強勢領軍日經指數補漲行情。台股雖呈高檔震盪，但AI硬體升級概念股維持強勁動能，載板與銅箔基板(CCL)族群逆勢上揚，其中聯茂更是亮燈漲停。
法人指出，近期PCB個股逆勢上揚，反映資金正由純AI晶片概念擴散至整體AI硬體供應鏈(如ABF載板、PCB及伺服器設備)。009828聚焦台、日、韓三地的PCB產業鏈龍頭，前十大持股涵蓋欣興、Ibiden、台光電、日東電工、臻鼎-KY、金像電、台燿與南電等關鍵企業。
根據TPCA與工研院產科國際所最新研究，全球載板產值預估於2025年達到147.5億美元(年增18.5%)，2026年更將在AI伺服器、高速交換器與先進封裝需求帶動下，進一步成長至195.1億美元(年增32.3%)，長線成長趨勢明確。
中信台日韓PCB ETF經理人葉松炫表示，過去PCB產業景氣循環較容易受到PC與智慧型手機需求影響，但隨著AI伺服器逐漸成為產業新的成長引擎，市場結構正出現明顯轉變。由於AI伺服器所需PCB層數、材料規格及單機價值均顯著高於傳統伺服器，使產業成長動能不再僅來自出貨量增加，更受惠於產品規格升級所帶來的價值提升。
葉松炫指出，在全球科技巨頭持續擴大AI資料中心投資的帶動下，AI產業發展已從晶片設計與先進製程，進一步延伸至ABF載板、高階PCB及關鍵材料等領域。隨著AI應用持續普及，相關供應鏈可望持續受惠於資料中心建置與硬體升級需求，長線成長潛力值得關注。

paras_en: Japan's stock market resumed trading on the 24th after a three‑day holiday, drawing a notable capital rebound; at the same time, Taiwan's CCL sector shed the previous "downgrade ghost story" gloom, spurring the entire PCB segment to rise together. Driven by a synchronized Taiwan‑Japan supply chain, the China Trust Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB ETF (009828‑TW) showed strong rebound power, with its price on the 24th back at the NT$10 issue price, closing up 1.73% at NT$10.02 and up 7.28% for the week. Overall trading activity kept warming, reflecting a renewed strong focus of market funds.

009828 listed in early September and was immediately hit by market headwinds, trading below its issue price in many places, but this week it staged a robust rebound, mainly thanks to the resonant effect of AI supply chains in both Taiwan and Japan. In Japan, AI server and high‑performance computing (HPC) demand lifted global IC substrate leader Ibiden, whose shares surged more than 15% intraday, leading a Nikkei rebound. Taiwan’s market, though trading in a high‑range range‑bound manner, saw AI hardware upgrade concept stocks maintain strong momentum, with substrate and copper‑foil board (CCL) groups climbing against the trend, and Lianmao hitting a limit‑up.

Institutional investors note that recent PCB stocks are rising against the tide, indicating capital is shifting from pure AI chip concepts to the broader AI hardware supply chain (such as ABF substrates, PCBs and server equipment). 009828 focuses on the PCB industry leaders in Taiwan, Japan and Korea, with its top ten holdings covering key firms like Unimicron, Ibiden, Taiwan‑Optoelectronics, Nitto Denko, Zhen Ding‑KY, Golden Image, Taiwan‑Yao and Nan‑Dian.

According to the latest research by TPCA and the Industrial Technology Research Institute’s International Production Center, global substrate output is projected to reach $14.75 billion in 2025 (up 18.5% YoY) and to grow further to $19.51 billion in 2026 (up 32.3% YoY) driven by AI servers, high‑speed switches and advanced packaging demand, underscoring a clear long‑term growth trend.

China Trust Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB ETF manager Yeh Song‑hsuan said that the PCB industry's business cycle used to be heavily influenced by PC and smartphone demand, but as AI servers become a new growth engine, the market structure is shifting markedly. Because AI servers require PCBs with more layers, higher‑grade materials and a higher unit value than traditional servers, industry growth now stems not only from volume increases but also from value added by upgraded specifications.

Yeh added that, propelled by global tech giants continuously expanding AI data‑center investments, AI development has moved beyond chip design and advanced processes to include ABF substrates, high‑end PCBs and critical materials. As AI applications keep spreading, the related supply chain is expected to benefit continuously from data‑center builds and hardware upgrades, offering notable long‑term growth potential.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉ABF載板供需缺口續擴大 欣興滾量重返千金周漲20%
items.title_en: Hot Stock: ABF Substrate Supply‑Demand Gap Continues to Widen, Unimicron’s Volume Rises, Returns to Thousand‑Dollar Week Up 20%
paras: AI大量需求推升需求，外資高盛報告指出ABF載板供需缺口擴大之中，明、後年缺口尤甚，刺激載板欣興(3037-TW)重獲買盤本周股價重獲買盤擁抱，本周外資買超14324張，股價收在1185元，漲幅20.8%，並站上所有均線。
PCB及IC載板廠欣興最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收以177.46億元創新高，月增9.18%，年增56.26%，欣興2026年1-8月營收1143.35億元，年增34.16%。欣興 2026 年上半年 營收爲 625.56 億元，毛利率 21.61%，年增 8.39 個百分點，上半年稅後純益 193.56 億元，年增 18.23 倍，每股純益達 11.7 元。
欣興因 AI 及 HPC 需求強勁，2026 上半年 AI 產品占比已超過 60%，下半年可望提升到 70%，欣興並且樂觀看待下半年營收持續成長。
欣興本周獲外資買超14324張，股價收在1185元，漲幅20.8%，並站上所有均線，技術線型呈現多頭排列，短線支撐在5日線1093元。
paras_en: AI's massive demand is boosting demand. A foreign‑capital Goldman Sachs report points out that the supply‑demand gap for ABF substrates is widening, with the gap especially large in the next two years, spurring substrate maker Unimicron (3037‑TW) to regain buying interest. This week the stock was embraced by buyers, with foreign investors net buying 14,324 lots, closing at NT$1,185, up 20.8%, and it rose above all moving averages.

PCB and IC substrate manufacturer Unimicron's latest revenue figures show that revenue in August 2026 reached a record high of NT$17.746 billion, up 9.18% month‑on‑month and 56.26% year‑on‑year. Unimicron's revenue for January‑August 2026 was NT$114.335 billion, a 34.16% annual increase. In the first half of 2026, revenue was NT$62.556 billion, gross margin 21.61% (up 8.39 percentage points year‑over‑year). First‑half net profit after tax was NT$19.356 billion, 18.23 times higher year‑over‑year, and earnings per share reached NT$11.7.

Because of strong AI and HPC demand, AI products accounted for more than 60% of Unimicron's sales in the first half of 2026, and are expected to rise to 70% in the second half. Unimicron is also optimistic that revenue will continue to grow in the second half.

This week Unimicron was net bought by foreign investors for 14,324 lots, closing at NT$1,185, up 20.8%, and it rose above all moving averages. The technical chart shows a bullish arrangement, with short‑term support at the 5‑day line of NT$1,093.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉Gogolook搭資安議題 周漲25%股價創掛牌上市以來新高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Gogolook Leverages Cybersecurity Theme, Shares Surge 25% to All-Time High Since IPO
paras: 台灣數位信任協會正式發起「台灣資安日」倡議，致力將資安防線推進民眾的日常生活，而信任科技服務商Gogolook(6902-TW)在國內外防詐版圖持續擴張，營收獲利同步創高，也受到多方追捧，本周股價大漲25%，最高來到183元，創掛牌上市以來新高。
據國家安全局最新數據指出，台灣每日承受超過 260 萬次網路威脅，高居亞太之首，今年詐騙手法更進化為結合 Deepfake 視訊、假帳單和私訊誘導的「混合式攻擊」，但財團法人台灣網路資訊中心(TWNIC)最新調查卻顯示，高達60%民眾從未查證資訊真偽，因此，台灣數位信任協會發起台灣資安日倡議。
Gogolook表示，下半年營收持續成長、營運規模突破關鍵門檻，帶動獲利隨營收規模同步放大，加上 AI 應用持續提升營運效率，樂觀看待下半年獲利動能強勁，可望優於上半年。
Gogolook前8月合併營收 8.35 億元，年增 28.2%，創同期新高，反映消費者防詐、企業端防詐和金融科技服務等三大業務同步擴張。
在企業端防詐服務方面，隨著各國政府持續強化防詐作為，法規趨勢加重企業防詐責任，帶動需求顯著升溫，Gogolook看好今明年陸續轉化為實質訂單，可望達成高成長。
其中，Gogolook防詐情資解決方案(ASI)在日本與合作夥伴推廣順利，營收已開始具規模並持續放大，正加大拓展更多海外市場。
而消費者防詐服務方面，Gogolook指出，目前數位廣告營收趨勢優於預期，將加大 Whoscall 全球用戶規模，目前泰國曼谷已擁有廣大用戶基礎，聚焦在曼谷以外地區和菲律賓等市場發展。
paras_en: The Taiwan Digital Trust Association officially launched the “Taiwan Cybersecurity Day” initiative, aiming to bring cybersecurity defenses into everyday life. Trust technology provider Gogolook (6902‑TW), which is expanding its anti‑fraud footprint both domestically and abroad, has seen revenues and profits hit new peaks and attracted widespread attention. This week its stock jumped 25%, reaching a high of NT$183, a record since its listing.

According to the latest data from the National Security Bureau, Taiwan faces more than 2.6 million online threats per day, the highest in the Asia‑Pacific region. This year, fraud tactics have evolved into “hybrid attacks” that combine deep‑fake videos, fake invoices and private‑message lures. Yet a recent survey by the Taiwan Network Information Center (TWNIC) shows that as many as 60 % of the public never verify the authenticity of information, prompting the Taiwan Digital Trust Association to launch the Taiwan Cybersecurity Day campaign.

Gogolook said that revenue will continue to grow in the second half of the year and that its operating scale has crossed a critical threshold, driving profit to expand in line with revenue. With AI applications further boosting operational efficiency, the company is optimistic about strong profit momentum in the second half, expecting performance to outpace the first half.

Gogolook reported combined revenue of NT$8.35 billion for the first eight months, up 28.2 % year‑on‑year and reaching a new high for the period. The growth reflects simultaneous expansion across its three core businesses: consumer anti‑fraud services, enterprise anti‑fraud solutions, and fintech offerings.

On the enterprise anti‑fraud side, governments worldwide are tightening anti‑fraud measures and regulations are increasing corporate responsibility for fraud prevention, heating up demand. Gogolook expects these trends to translate into concrete orders over the next two years, delivering high growth potential.

Gogolook’s anti‑fraud intelligence solution (ASI) has been successfully promoted in Japan together with partners; revenue from this line has already begun to scale and continues to expand, and the company is intensifying efforts to enter additional overseas markets.

Regarding consumer anti‑fraud services, Gogolook noted that digital‑advertising revenue is exceeding expectations. It will further expand the global user base of its Whoscall app, already strong in Bangkok, Thailand, and is now focusing on growth beyond Bangkok and into markets such as the Philippines.

items.title: 川習會白宮國宴科技大咖雲集！黃仁勳、庫克、蘇姿丰同桌 中方無企業家出席
items.title_en: Trump Hosts Xi at White House State Dinner, Tech Titans Gather: Jensen Huang, Tim Cook, Lisa Su Share a Table While No Chinese CEOs Attend
paras: 美國總統川普周四(24日)在白宮設國宴款待中國國家主席習近平，華爾街與矽谷重量級人物齊聚，凸顯美國科技與金融界的影響力。相較之下，中國代表團則無中國企業主參與，凸顯雙方對這次峰會的期待可能有落差。
從美媒照片與報導來看，習近平與川普同桌，同席者包括輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳與妻子Lori Huang、蘋果(AAPL-US)執行長庫克(Tim Cook)，以及超微(AMD-US)執行長蘇姿丰(Lisa Su)與丈夫Daniel Lin 。值得注意的是，美國目前仍禁止輝達部分先進晶片出口中國。
在美中爭相主導人工智慧(AI)之際，川普本周以罕見的國事訪問規格接待習近平。習近平稍後表示，中美可持續就AI議題對話，並共同防範AI遭到濫用。

國宴嘉賓凸顯科技分量

根據路透整理出的名單，其他受邀科技領袖還包括Meta(META-US)執行長祖克伯(Mark Zuckerberg)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)創辦人貝佐斯(Jeff Bezos)、特斯拉(TSLA-US)和SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長Elon Musk、OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)、微軟(MSFT-US)執行長納德拉(Satya Nadella)、戴爾科技(DELL-US)執行長Michael Dell、美光(MU-US)執行長Sanjay Mehrotra及高通(QCOM-US)執行長Cristiano Amon。
金融界則有花旗(C-US)執行長Jane Fraser、摩根大通(JPM-US)執行長戴蒙(Jamie Dimon)、黑石(BX-US)執行長Stephen Schwarzman、高盛(GS-US)執行長蘇德蘶(David Solomon)，以及萬事達卡(MA-US)執行長Michael Miebach。
政治圈部分，美國財長貝森特(Scott Bessent)、商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)、能源部長萊特(Chris Wright)、美國貿易代表格里爾(Jamieson Greer)，以及聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)和妻子、雅詩蘭黛(Estée Lauder Companies)創辦人孫女珍勞黛(Jane Lauder)也在賓客名單上。

名單中也出現波音(BA-US)執行長、洛克希德馬丁(LMT-US)、通用汽車(GM-US)、埃克森美孚(XOM-US)、輝瑞(PFE-US)等企業執行長，以及LVMH董事長阿諾德(Bernard Arnault)，和美國總統科學與技術顧問委員會成員與Craft Ventures創辦人薩克斯(David Sacks)。川普家族成員伊凡卡(Ivanka Trump)、Eric Trump、Lara Trump及Tiffany Trump也在名單上。

中國代表19人清一色官員與眷屬

相較之下，中國今年稍早為川普舉辦的宴會中，美方貴賓主要與親屬及美中代表團官員同桌。
彭博指出，這次超過130名賓客中，中方代表僅19人，而且清一色是官員與眷屬、沒有中國企業領袖，凸顯兩國對此次峰會的期待可能存在差異。
在峰會前，川普曾形容這場國宴是「城裡最熱門的門票」，形容「每個人都想來」，賓客涵蓋「整個科技界、整個銀行界，以及更多人」。
這場國宴共三道菜，包括黃櫛瓜濃湯、芝麻脆皮鱸魚以及香草乳霜佐蜂蜜冰淇淋，菜單以「美國食材搭配細微中國風味」為特色。白宮表示，開場將以加州史瑞堡酒莊(Schramsberg)「Blanc De Noirs」氣泡酒祝酒，該酒款也曾在1972年美國前總統尼克森訪問北京時供應。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday (the 24th) hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping at a state dinner in the White House, drawing heavyweight figures from Wall Street and Silicon Valley and underscoring the influence of America’s tech and finance sectors. In contrast, the Chinese delegation included no Chinese business owners, highlighting a possible mismatch in expectations for the summit.

Photos and reports from U.S. media show Xi sitting at the same table as Trump, alongside NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang and his wife Lori Huang, Apple (AAPL-US) CEO Tim Cook, and AMD (AMD-US) CEO Lisa Su with her husband Daniel Lin. It is noteworthy that the United States still bans the export of certain advanced NVIDIA chips to China.

As the United States and China race to dominate artificial intelligence (AI), Trump welcomed Xi this week with a rare state‑visit format. Xi later said the two countries can continue dialogue on AI and work together to prevent its misuse.

The guest list highlighted the weight of the tech sector. According to a Reuters‑compiled list, other invited tech leaders included Meta (META‑US) CEO Mark Zuckerberg, Amazon (AMZN‑US) founder Jeff Bezos, Tesla (TSLA‑US) and SpaceX (SPCX‑US) CEO Elon Musk, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Microsoft (MSFT‑US) CEO Satya Nadella, Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) CEO Michael Dell, Micron (MU‑US) CEO Sanjay Mehrotra and Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) CEO Cristiano Amon.

From the finance world, guests included Citigroup (C‑US) CEO Jane Fraser, JPMorgan Chase (JPM‑US) CEO Jamie Dimon, Blackstone (BX‑US) CEO Stephen Schwarzman, Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) CEO David Solomon, and Mastercard (MA‑US) CEO Michael Miebach.

On the political side, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, Energy Secretary Chris Wright, U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer, Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh and his wife Jane Lauder – granddaughter of Estée Lauder Companies founder – were also on the guest list.

The list also featured CEOs of Boeing (BA‑US), Lockheed Martin (LMT‑US), General Motors (GM‑US), Exxon Mobil (XOM‑US), Pfizer (PFE‑US) and LVMH chairman Bernard Arnault, as well as David Sacks, a member of the President’s Science and Technology Advisory Committee and founder of Craft Ventures. Trump family members Ivanka Trump, Eric Trump, Lara Trump and Tiffany Trump were also invited.
China’s 19‑person delegation consisted entirely of officials and their families, with no business leaders among them.
Bloomberg noted that of the more than 130 guests, only 19 were from the Chinese side, all officials or family members, underscoring a possible divergence in what each side expects from the summit.

Before the summit, Trump described the state dinner as “the hottest ticket in town,” saying “everyone wants to come,” and said the guest list spanned “the entire tech sector, the entire banking sector, and beyond.”

The three‑course dinner featured zucchini soup, sesame‑crusted sea bass and herb‑cream‑topped honey ice cream, with a menu described as “American ingredients with subtle Chinese flavors.” The White House said the evening began with a toast of Schramsberg “Blanc De Noirs” sparkling wine, the same wine served when President Nixon visited Beijing in 1972.

items.title: 美國擴大制裁伊朗航空業 阿聯宣布停飛伊朗航空公司航班
items.title_en: U.S. Expands Sanctions on Iran's Aviation Industry; UAE Announces Suspension of Flights to Iranian Airlines
paras: 美國擴大對伊朗航空業的制裁後，阿拉伯聯合大公國週四 (24 日) 宣布，即日起暫停所有伊朗航空公司往返阿聯的航班，恢復時間未定。伊朗飛往周邊國家的多條航線也受到影響，顯示美國針對與伊朗企業往來的第三國業者施壓，已開始衝擊實際航班運作。
美國先前宣布，9 月 23 日後繼續與伊朗航空公司往來的境外企業，可能面臨制裁。美國財政部本月初已將 27 家伊朗航空公司列入制裁名單，並擴大對協助伊朗航空業者的第三國企業施加制裁的範圍。
伊朗飛往阿曼、喬治亞、亞塞拜然及伊拉克首都巴格達的航班也已停飛；當局正設法將部分伊拉克航班改飛納傑夫 (Najaf)。
另一方面，德黑蘭伊瑪目何梅尼國際機場 (Imam Khomeini International Airport)週四的班表仍列有往返中國、土耳其、巴基斯坦等國的航班，因此目前不能將航線受限解讀為伊朗所有國際航班停飛。
限制也波及空域使用。
伊朗民航組織發言人阿赫萬 (Majid Akhavan)表示，一架從德黑蘭飛往塔吉克首都杜尚別的航班，因土庫曼不允許伊朗飛機飛越其領空，被迫折返。他說，伊朗正透過外交與航空管道磋商，希望解除限制並恢復往返阿聯的航班。
航空禁令若持續，可能使已受美國海上封鎖影響的伊朗進一步孤立。
伊朗一名高階官員週三警告，區域內若有國家配合美國禁令，其機場可能遭到報復。這是伊朗官員的威脅，目前並非已發生的行動。
中東其他戰線同時升溫。沙烏地阿拉伯週四表示，攔截了葉門青年運動發射的 6 枚彈道飛彈；青年運動則稱，已對沙國目標發射數十枚飛彈與無人機。這場衝突與航空制裁分屬不同事件，但都發生在區域戰事擴大的背景下。
paras_en: After the United States expanded sanctions on Iran's aviation sector, the United Arab Emirates on Thursday (the 24th) announced that, effective immediately, all flights by Iranian airlines to and from the UAE are suspended, with no set date for resumption. Several routes from Iran to neighboring countries are also affected, showing that U.S. pressure on third‑party operators dealing with Iranian firms is now impacting actual flight operations.

The United States previously warned that foreign companies continuing to do business with Iranian airlines after September 23 could face sanctions. Earlier this month, the U.S. Treasury added 27 Iranian airlines to its sanctions list and broadened the scope of penalties on third‑country firms that assist Iran’s aviation industry.
Flights from Iran to Oman, Georgia, Azerbaijan and Iraq’s capital Baghdad have also been halted; authorities are working to reroute some Iraq‑bound flights to Najaf.

On the other hand, the schedule at Tehran’s Imam Khomeini International Airport still shows flights to and from China, Turkey, Pakistan and other countries, so the route restrictions cannot be taken as a complete shutdown of all Iran‑international flights at this time.
The restrictions also extend to the use of airspace.

Majid Akhavan, a spokesperson for Iran’s Civil Aviation Organization, said a flight from Tehran to Tajikistan’s capital Dushanbe was forced to turn back because Turkmenistan would not allow the Iranian aircraft to overfly its airspace. He said Iran is pursuing diplomatic and aviation‑channel talks to lift the restrictions and restore flights to the UAE.
If the aviation ban persists, it could further isolate Iran, which is already feeling the effects of a U.S. maritime blockade.

A senior Iranian official warned on Wednesday that any regional country that complies with the U.S. ban could see its airports targeted in retaliation. This is a threat from Iranian officials, not an action that has yet occurred.

Tensions on other Middle‑East fronts are also rising. Saudi Arabia said on Thursday that it intercepted six ballistic missiles launched by Yemen’s Houthi movement; the Houthis claim they have fired dozens of missiles and drones at Saudi targets. This conflict is separate from the aviation sanctions but occurs against the backdrop of an expanding regional war.

items.title: 「搶配額」大戰落幕！經部落槌：輸歐鋼品總額分3次開放、自由配額減半
items.title_en: "Quota Battle" Ends! Ministry of Economic Affairs Strikes: EU Steel Export Quota Split into Three Rounds, Free Quota Halved
paras: 對近期鋼鐵業者高度關注的我國金屬塗層鋼板（輸歐鋼品第4A類別）出口歐盟管理措施，經濟部昨（24）日緊急邀集代表性鋼鐵業者、貿易商及鋼鐵公會等各方代表，展開長達5小時的跨部會與產業深度研商。經濟部今（25）日正式對外宣布，雙方已達成重大共識，決定將「自由申請配額」占比由原本的20%調降至10%，且總額將平均分三次開放申請，有效避免開開放即被一搶而空的亂象，全力維護我國鋼鐵外銷秩序。

因應歐盟關稅防衛 經濟部跨部會共識敲定

經濟部說明，歐盟自2019年起對進口鋼鐵實施關稅配額防衛措施，並給予台灣特定的國家配額。為維持鋼品輸歐秩序，政府與鋼鐵公會及業界共同研擬出配額機制，將國家配額劃分為「出口實績」與「自由申請配額」兩大類。若業界無特別共識，先前預設自由配額占比為20%。
隨著歐盟鋼鐵防衛措施於今（2026）年6月底屆期，歐盟自7月1日起繼續以關稅配額方式管制鋼品輸入，並新增金屬塗層鋼板的國家配額。為協助國內業者穩健拓展歐盟市場，經濟部比照先前機制公告相關規範，並續由鋼鐵公會辦理受理、審查與分配作業。

審查機制透明化 配額改分三次申請避免秒殺

鋼鐵公會於會中強調，針對4A類別的「自由申請配額」，公會始終秉持公平公正原則，嚴格落實資格審查與合約規範，並依據合格總申請量的比例公開計算與登錄分配，確保各家業者權益。
為了解決業者反映「剛開放申請配額就被搶光」的痛點，會中經充分溝通後達成兩項關鍵調整：
配額比例調降： 金屬塗層鋼板的「自由申請配額」占比由20%調降至10%，擴大實績業者的穩定配額。
分階段開放申請： 自由配額總額將採取平均分三次申請的方式發放，防範短時間內配額耗盡。
經濟部強調，政府高度重視鋼鐵業者的出口利益，未來將因應國際經貿情勢變化，持續與業界保持密切溝通，並滾動式檢討各類輸歐鋼品的分配機制，協助台灣鋼鐵產業在國際市場立於不敗之地。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs held an emergency five‑hour inter‑agency and industry round‑table yesterday (the 24th) to discuss Taiwan’s metal‑coated steel sheet (Category 4A steel exports to the EU), which has drawn intense attention from the steel sector. The ministry announced today (the 25th) that a major consensus has been reached: the share of “free‑application quota” will be cut from the original 20% to 10%, and the total amount will be released in three equal batches, preventing the chaos of the quota being snapped up instantly and fully safeguarding Taiwan’s steel export order.

The ministry explained that the EU has applied anti‑dumping tariff‑quota safeguards on imported steel since 2019 and granted Taiwan a specific national quota. To maintain orderly steel exports to the EU, the government, together with the steel association and industry, devised a quota mechanism that divides the national quota into “export‑performance quota” and “free‑application quota.” In the absence of a specific industry agreement, the free quota was previously set at 20%.

As the EU’s steel defence measures expire at the end of June 2026, the EU will continue to regulate steel imports via tariff‑quota from July 1 and has added a national quota for metal‑coated steel sheets. To help domestic firms steadily expand into the EU market, the Ministry of Economic Affairs announced the relevant rules based on the previous mechanism and will continue to have the Steel Association handle applications, reviews and allocations.

The Steel Association emphasized during the meeting that for the 4A “free‑application quota,” it will always uphold fairness and impartiality, strictly enforce eligibility checks and contract standards, and publicly calculate and record allocations based on the proportion of qualified total applications, ensuring the rights of all firms.
To address industry complaints that “the quota is snatched up as soon as it opens,” the meeting, after thorough discussion, agreed on two key adjustments:
Quota share reduction: the “free‑application quota” for metal‑coated steel sheets will be lowered from 20% to 10%, expanding stable allocations for firms with proven export performance.
Staged application: the total free quota will be distributed in three equal rounds, preventing the quota from being exhausted in a short period.

The ministry stressed that the government places great importance on the export interests of steel companies and will, in response to changing international trade conditions, maintain close communication with the industry and continuously review the allocation mechanisms for all EU‑bound steel products, helping Taiwan’s steel sector remain competitive in the global market.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉PCB擺脫鬼故事！台日供應鏈點火 009828周漲逾7%重返發行價
items.title_en: Hot Stock: PCB Breaks the Ghost Story! Taiwan-Japan Supply Chain Ignites, 009828 Gains Over 7% This Week, Returns to Issue Price
paras: 日本股市在結束三天假期後於 24 日恢復交易，吸引資金顯著回補；同時，台股 CCL 族群擺脫先前「降級鬼故事」陰霾，激勵整體 PCB 類股近期連袂上揚。在台日兩地供應鏈齊揚的帶動下，中信台日韓 PCB(009828-TW)展現強勁反彈力道，24 日股價順利站回 10 元發行價，終場上漲 1.73% 收在 10.02 元，單周累計漲幅達 7.28%。整體交投表現持續增溫，反映市場資金關注重心再度強勢回歸。
009828於9月初掛牌，隨即遭遇市場利空，多處於破發狀況，但本周展開強勁反彈，主要歸功於台日兩地 AI 供應鏈的共振效應，日股方面，受惠AI伺服器與高效能運算(HPC)需求，全球IC載板龍頭Ibiden(揖斐電)盤中一度暴漲逾15%，強勢領軍日經指數補漲行情。台股雖呈高檔震盪，但AI硬體升級概念股維持強勁動能，載板與銅箔基板(CCL)族群逆勢上揚，其中聯茂更是亮燈漲停。
法人指出，近期PCB個股逆勢上揚，反映資金正由純AI晶片概念擴散至整體AI硬體供應鏈(如ABF載板、PCB及伺服器設備)。009828聚焦台、日、韓三地的PCB產業鏈龍頭，前十大持股涵蓋欣興、Ibiden、台光電、日東電工、臻鼎-KY、金像電、台燿與南電等關鍵企業。
根據TPCA與工研院產科國際所最新研究，全球載板產值預估於2025年達到147.5億美元(年增18.5%)，2026年更將在AI伺服器、高速交換器與先進封裝需求帶動下，進一步成長至195.1億美元(年增32.3%)，長線成長趨勢明確。
中信台日韓PCB ETF經理人葉松炫表示，過去PCB產業景氣循環較容易受到PC與智慧型手機需求影響，但隨著AI伺服器逐漸成為產業新的成長引擎，市場結構正出現明顯轉變。由於AI伺服器所需PCB層數、材料規格及單機價值均顯著高於傳統伺服器，使產業成長動能不再僅來自出貨量增加，更受惠於產品規格升級所帶來的價值提升。
葉松炫指出，在全球科技巨頭持續擴大AI資料中心投資的帶動下，AI產業發展已從晶片設計與先進製程，進一步延伸至ABF載板、高階PCB及關鍵材料等領域。隨著AI應用持續普及，相關供應鏈可望持續受惠於資料中心建置與硬體升級需求，長線成長潛力值得關注。

paras_en: Japan's stock market resumed trading on the 24th after a three‑day holiday, drawing a notable capital rebound; at the same time, Taiwan's CCL sector shed the previous "downgrade ghost story" gloom, spurring the entire PCB segment to rise together. Driven by a synchronized Taiwan‑Japan supply chain, the China Trust Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB ETF (009828‑TW) showed strong rebound power, with its price on the 24th back at the NT$10 issue price, closing up 1.73% at NT$10.02 and up 7.28% for the week. Overall trading activity kept warming, reflecting a renewed strong focus of market funds.

009828 listed in early September and was immediately hit by market headwinds, trading below its issue price in many places, but this week it staged a robust rebound, mainly thanks to the resonant effect of AI supply chains in both Taiwan and Japan. In Japan, AI server and high‑performance computing (HPC) demand lifted global IC substrate leader Ibiden, whose shares surged more than 15% intraday, leading a Nikkei rebound. Taiwan’s market, though trading in a high‑range range‑bound manner, saw AI hardware upgrade concept stocks maintain strong momentum, with substrate and copper‑foil board (CCL) groups climbing against the trend, and Lianmao hitting a limit‑up.

Institutional investors note that recent PCB stocks are rising against the tide, indicating capital is shifting from pure AI chip concepts to the broader AI hardware supply chain (such as ABF substrates, PCBs and server equipment). 009828 focuses on the PCB industry leaders in Taiwan, Japan and Korea, with its top ten holdings covering key firms like Unimicron, Ibiden, Taiwan‑Optoelectronics, Nitto Denko, Zhen Ding‑KY, Golden Image, Taiwan‑Yao and Nan‑Dian.

According to the latest research by TPCA and the Industrial Technology Research Institute’s International Production Center, global substrate output is projected to reach $14.75 billion in 2025 (up 18.5% YoY) and to grow further to $19.51 billion in 2026 (up 32.3% YoY) driven by AI servers, high‑speed switches and advanced packaging demand, underscoring a clear long‑term growth trend.

China Trust Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB ETF manager Yeh Song‑hsuan said that the PCB industry's business cycle used to be heavily influenced by PC and smartphone demand, but as AI servers become a new growth engine, the market structure is shifting markedly. Because AI servers require PCBs with more layers, higher‑grade materials and a higher unit value than traditional servers, industry growth now stems not only from volume increases but also from value added by upgraded specifications.

Yeh added that, propelled by global tech giants continuously expanding AI data‑center investments, AI development has moved beyond chip design and advanced processes to include ABF substrates, high‑end PCBs and critical materials. As AI applications keep spreading, the related supply chain is expected to benefit continuously from data‑center builds and hardware upgrades, offering notable long‑term growth potential.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉ABF載板供需缺口續擴大 欣興滾量重返千金周漲20%
items.title_en: Hot Stock: ABF Substrate Supply‑Demand Gap Continues to Widen, Unimicron’s Volume Rises, Returns to Thousand‑Dollar Week Up 20%
paras: AI大量需求推升需求，外資高盛報告指出ABF載板供需缺口擴大之中，明、後年缺口尤甚，刺激載板欣興(3037-TW)重獲買盤本周股價重獲買盤擁抱，本周外資買超14324張，股價收在1185元，漲幅20.8%，並站上所有均線。
PCB及IC載板廠欣興最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收以177.46億元創新高，月增9.18%，年增56.26%，欣興2026年1-8月營收1143.35億元，年增34.16%。欣興 2026 年上半年 營收爲 625.56 億元，毛利率 21.61%，年增 8.39 個百分點，上半年稅後純益 193.56 億元，年增 18.23 倍，每股純益達 11.7 元。
欣興因 AI 及 HPC 需求強勁，2026 上半年 AI 產品占比已超過 60%，下半年可望提升到 70%，欣興並且樂觀看待下半年營收持續成長。
欣興本周獲外資買超14324張，股價收在1185元，漲幅20.8%，並站上所有均線，技術線型呈現多頭排列，短線支撐在5日線1093元。
paras_en: AI's massive demand is boosting demand. A foreign‑capital Goldman Sachs report points out that the supply‑demand gap for ABF substrates is widening, with the gap especially large in the next two years, spurring substrate maker Unimicron (3037‑TW) to regain buying interest. This week the stock was embraced by buyers, with foreign investors net buying 14,324 lots, closing at NT$1,185, up 20.8%, and it rose above all moving averages.

PCB and IC substrate manufacturer Unimicron's latest revenue figures show that revenue in August 2026 reached a record high of NT$17.746 billion, up 9.18% month‑on‑month and 56.26% year‑on‑year. Unimicron's revenue for January‑August 2026 was NT$114.335 billion, a 34.16% annual increase. In the first half of 2026, revenue was NT$62.556 billion, gross margin 21.61% (up 8.39 percentage points year‑over‑year). First‑half net profit after tax was NT$19.356 billion, 18.23 times higher year‑over‑year, and earnings per share reached NT$11.7.

Because of strong AI and HPC demand, AI products accounted for more than 60% of Unimicron's sales in the first half of 2026, and are expected to rise to 70% in the second half. Unimicron is also optimistic that revenue will continue to grow in the second half.

This week Unimicron was net bought by foreign investors for 14,324 lots, closing at NT$1,185, up 20.8%, and it rose above all moving averages. The technical chart shows a bullish arrangement, with short‑term support at the 5‑day line of NT$1,093.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉Gogolook搭資安議題 周漲25%股價創掛牌上市以來新高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Gogolook Leverages Cybersecurity Theme, Shares Surge 25% to All-Time High Since IPO
paras: 台灣數位信任協會正式發起「台灣資安日」倡議，致力將資安防線推進民眾的日常生活，而信任科技服務商Gogolook(6902-TW)在國內外防詐版圖持續擴張，營收獲利同步創高，也受到多方追捧，本周股價大漲25%，最高來到183元，創掛牌上市以來新高。
據國家安全局最新數據指出，台灣每日承受超過 260 萬次網路威脅，高居亞太之首，今年詐騙手法更進化為結合 Deepfake 視訊、假帳單和私訊誘導的「混合式攻擊」，但財團法人台灣網路資訊中心(TWNIC)最新調查卻顯示，高達60%民眾從未查證資訊真偽，因此，台灣數位信任協會發起台灣資安日倡議。
Gogolook表示，下半年營收持續成長、營運規模突破關鍵門檻，帶動獲利隨營收規模同步放大，加上 AI 應用持續提升營運效率，樂觀看待下半年獲利動能強勁，可望優於上半年。
Gogolook前8月合併營收 8.35 億元，年增 28.2%，創同期新高，反映消費者防詐、企業端防詐和金融科技服務等三大業務同步擴張。
在企業端防詐服務方面，隨著各國政府持續強化防詐作為，法規趨勢加重企業防詐責任，帶動需求顯著升溫，Gogolook看好今明年陸續轉化為實質訂單，可望達成高成長。
其中，Gogolook防詐情資解決方案(ASI)在日本與合作夥伴推廣順利，營收已開始具規模並持續放大，正加大拓展更多海外市場。
而消費者防詐服務方面，Gogolook指出，目前數位廣告營收趨勢優於預期，將加大 Whoscall 全球用戶規模，目前泰國曼谷已擁有廣大用戶基礎，聚焦在曼谷以外地區和菲律賓等市場發展。
paras_en: The Taiwan Digital Trust Association officially launched the “Taiwan Cybersecurity Day” initiative, aiming to bring cybersecurity defenses into everyday life. Trust technology provider Gogolook (6902‑TW), which is expanding its anti‑fraud footprint both domestically and abroad, has seen revenues and profits hit new peaks and attracted widespread attention. This week its stock jumped 25%, reaching a high of NT$183, a record since its listing.

According to the latest data from the National Security Bureau, Taiwan faces more than 2.6 million online threats per day, the highest in the Asia‑Pacific region. This year, fraud tactics have evolved into “hybrid attacks” that combine deep‑fake videos, fake invoices and private‑message lures. Yet a recent survey by the Taiwan Network Information Center (TWNIC) shows that as many as 60 % of the public never verify the authenticity of information, prompting the Taiwan Digital Trust Association to launch the Taiwan Cybersecurity Day campaign.

Gogolook said that revenue will continue to grow in the second half of the year and that its operating scale has crossed a critical threshold, driving profit to expand in line with revenue. With AI applications further boosting operational efficiency, the company is optimistic about strong profit momentum in the second half, expecting performance to outpace the first half.

Gogolook reported combined revenue of NT$8.35 billion for the first eight months, up 28.2 % year‑on‑year and reaching a new high for the period. The growth reflects simultaneous expansion across its three core businesses: consumer anti‑fraud services, enterprise anti‑fraud solutions, and fintech offerings.

On the enterprise anti‑fraud side, governments worldwide are tightening anti‑fraud measures and regulations are increasing corporate responsibility for fraud prevention, heating up demand. Gogolook expects these trends to translate into concrete orders over the next two years, delivering high growth potential.

Gogolook’s anti‑fraud intelligence solution (ASI) has been successfully promoted in Japan together with partners; revenue from this line has already begun to scale and continues to expand, and the company is intensifying efforts to enter additional overseas markets.

Regarding consumer anti‑fraud services, Gogolook noted that digital‑advertising revenue is exceeding expectations. It will further expand the global user base of its Whoscall app, already strong in Bangkok, Thailand, and is now focusing on growth beyond Bangkok and into markets such as the Philippines.

items.title: 我家地層安全嗎？最新土壤液化潛勢圖出爐 鑽孔「3倍增」輸地址秒查更精準
items.title_en: Is My Home’s Ground Safe? Latest Soil Liquefaction Potential Map Released, Drilling Triples, Address Input for More Precise Lookup
paras: 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心昨 （24）日發布115年土壤液化潛勢圖資最新更新。本次更新共涵蓋台北市、新北市、桃園市、宜蘭縣、新竹縣及新竹市等6縣市，經全面重新檢核後，有逾8成區域之土壤液化潛勢仍維持原判，未產生改變。地礦中心強調，當前分析地質鑽孔成長約3倍，尤其都會地區鑽井密度提高至每平方公里4孔，圖資品質與精準度大幅提升，民眾輸入地址即可查詢所在位置之潛勢分級及相關說明。
地礦中心表示，本次更新除土壤液化潛勢圖外，也同步提供軟弱土層分布圖及土壤液化監測站等資訊，可作為國土開發與安全利用之重要參考。本次分析採用長期觀測之淺層地下水位，並大幅增加高品質地質鑽井，分析地質鑽孔由前一版3571孔增加至11731孔，成長約3倍；分析範圍增加約96平方公里，整體分析面積達909.8平方公里。都會地區鑽井密度提高至每平方公里4孔，大幅提升圖資品質與精準度。
針對部分區域潛勢調整，地礦中心說明，此係基礎鑽孔資料與長期水位觀測資料增加後之修正，並非該地區地質條件發生變化。土壤液化潛勢圖係以原始地質條件進行區域性評估，位於高潛勢區並不代表建築物不安全。只要透過地盤改良、結構加固與確實之工程設計，即可有效確保房屋與生命財產安全。民眾及業者可至地礦中心網站進行簡易評估，開發時亦可委託專業技師辦理補充調查與施工改良。
本次圖資主要採集經濟部「土壤液化調查與風險評估計畫」及內政部「安家固園計畫」成果，由中央與地方政府合作產製。此外，地礦中心自110年起於全國設置土壤液化監測站，目前10處運作中、1處測試中，設置於公園或校園等空地，於地震發生時同步記錄地表震動、地層孔隙水壓及沉陷變形，累積自主觀測資料以精進評估方法。
更新後之土壤液化潛勢圖資已同步於「土壤液化潛勢查詢系統」(https://liquefaction.gsmma.gov.tw) 公開，民眾輸入地址即可查詢所在位置之潛勢分級及相關說明。地礦中心表示，地質調查資料將持續累積，地下水位亦隨季節及氣候變遷而變動。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Geological Survey and Mining Management Center released the latest update of the 2022 soil liquefaction potential map on the 24th. The update covers six jurisdictions—Taipei City, New Taipei City, Taoyuan City, Yilan County, Hsinchu County and Hsinchu City—and after a comprehensive re‑examination, more than 80% of the areas retain their original liquefaction potential ratings with no changes. The Center emphasized that the number of analyzed boreholes has grown about three‑fold, especially in urban areas where drilling density has risen to four holes per square kilometre, greatly improving the map’s quality and accuracy, and allowing the public to enter an address to instantly see the local risk level and related information.

The Center noted that, in addition to the liquefaction potential map, the update also provides a weak‑soil distribution map and information on soil‑liquefaction monitoring stations, which are important references for land development and safe use. The analysis used long‑term shallow groundwater‑level observations and a substantial increase in high‑quality boreholes, raising the number of analyzed boreholes from 3,571 in the previous version to 11,731—a three‑fold increase; the analysis area expanded by about 96 km², reaching a total of 909.8 km². Urban drilling density was increased to four holes per km², markedly enhancing the map’s quality and precision.

Regarding adjustments to the potential in some areas, the Center explained that these revisions stem from the addition of new borehole data and long‑term water‑level observations, not from changes in the underlying geological conditions. The liquefaction potential map assesses regional risk based on original geological conditions, and being in a high‑potential zone does not mean a building is unsafe. Proper ground improvement, structural reinforcement, and sound engineering design can effectively ensure the safety of homes and lives. The public and developers can perform a simple assessment on the Center’s website, and developers may also commission professional engineers for supplemental investigations and remedial works during development.

The map data were primarily compiled from the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ “Soil Liquefaction Survey and Risk Assessment Project” and the Ministry of the Interior’s “Safe Home, Secure Garden Project,” produced through central‑local government cooperation. Since 2021, the Center has installed soil‑liquefaction monitoring stations nationwide; currently ten are operational and one is in testing, located in open spaces such as parks or campuses. During earthquakes these stations record surface shaking, pore‑water pressure, and settlement deformation, accumulating independent observation data to refine assessment methods.

The updated soil‑liquefaction potential map is now available on the “Soil Liquefaction Potential Query System” (https://liquefaction.gsmma.gov.tw). By entering an address, the public can view the local risk classification and related explanations. The Center stated that geological survey data will continue to be accumulated, and groundwater levels will vary with seasons and climate change.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉富驊布局AI領域效益浮現2027年營運可期 周漲近3成
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Fu Hua’s AI Push Shows Benefits, 2027 Operations Expected, Weekly Rise Near 30%
paras: 富驊(5465-TW)積極布局AI業務，包括伺服器、網通及散熱等業務展望皆正面，加上明年泰國廠投產，將進一步貢獻，可望帶動明年營收與獲利表現，激勵富驊本周漲幅近3成，股價創近1年以來新高。
富驊本周漲幅28.09%，周一(21日)跳空漲停，周四(24日)收在最高34.2元，股價寫近1年以來新高，並站穩所有均線。三大法人也持續敲進富驊，連續9個交易日買超，合計買超340張。
富驊指出，高密度硬碟儲存系統訂單能見度看至2029年，為營收成長主要動能；HPC伺服器產品將於明年第一季貢獻，且因伺服器產品數高單價毛利產品，預期將帶來顯著營收與獲利貢獻；網通產品則有新世代1.6T傳輸速度交換器將於明年第一季出貨；光模組產品則預計明年放量。
同時，富驊也跨足水冷散熱領域，目前已有分歧管(Manifold)產品進到客戶送樣與驗證階段，預期將成為營運另一成長支柱。
此外，泰國廠將建立伺服器機殼生產能力，目前已取得HPC客戶海外生產及確認，預計明年加入生產行列後將帶來明顯貢獻。

The stock rose 28.09% this week, jumping to a limit‑up on Monday (the 21st) and closing at a peak of NT$34.2 on Thursday (the 24th, a one‑year high) while staying above all moving averages. The three major institutional investors kept buying Fu Hua, net‑buying for nine consecutive trading days, totaling 340 lots.

Fu Hua noted that orders for high‑density hard‑disk storage systems are visible through 2029, serving as the main driver of revenue growth; HPC server products will contribute in Q1 next year, and because server products are high‑price, high‑margin items, they are expected to bring significant revenue and profit contributions; networking products will see a new‑generation 1.6 Tbps switch ship in Q1 next year; and optical module products are slated for volume expansion next year.

At the same time, Fu Hua is also entering the water‑cooling sector; it already has a manifold product in the customer sampling and verification stage, which is expected to become another growth pillar for operations.

Furthermore, the Thailand plant will build server chassis production capacity. It has already secured overseas HPC customer production orders and confirmations, and is expected to make a noticeable contribution once it joins production next year.

items.title: 下周最值得留意的5大族群重點分析整理、以及該注意提防的風險
paras: 根據當下現況、產業趨勢、個別公司營運狀況及未來展望，透過ChatGPT，下周有哪些個股與族群值得留意、以及該注意提防的風險，重點分析整理
注意：以下是合理性模型，不是價格保證，請務必搭配資金管理與停損策略
指數高檔震盪不等於行情結束，反而更要從「指數行情」轉向「產業輪動＋獲利成長」；AI伺服器、CCL/PCB、散熱、ASIC/先進製程、記憶體仍是主要觀察軸線，但追高風險明顯提高。
一、下周最值得留意的5大族群
二、第一觀察主軸：AI伺服器＋電源
① 台達電（2308-TW）
我認為下周可以列為大型權值股中的重要觀察標的。
原因很簡單：AI伺服器功耗持續提高，從單純伺服器需求逐漸延伸到電源、散熱、液冷、資料中心基礎建設。
凱基9/16的電子硬體研究也將台達電（2308-TW）、奇鋐（3017-TW）、金像電（2368-TW）、台積電（2330-TW）、緯穎（6669-TW）、鴻海（2317-TW）等列入AI硬體產業研究範圍；而FactSet資料頁目前可見台達電2026年EPS預估曾上修至37.12元。
下周看什麼？

股價能否維持強勢整理
AI電源/資料中心營收成長是否延續
外資是否重新回補
若大盤震盪，台達電是否呈現「量縮抗跌」


**定位：**大型AI權值＋基本面型。
② 鴻海（2317-TW）
鴻海比較適合觀察「AI伺服器出貨能否繼續轉化為營收與獲利」。
23日鴻海股價上漲超過1%，同步受惠於電子權值股資金回流。
它的特色與純AI零組件不同：
AI伺服器組裝＋機櫃＋網通＋雲端客戶需求
所以如果下周市場由高價AI零組件轉向大型權值股，鴻海可能成為資金輪動觀察點。
三、第二主軸：CCL／PCB——目前盤面最值得追蹤的輪動方向之一
這一條我會特別留意：
台光電（2383-TW）
金像電（2368-TW）
24日早盤台股大跌時，CCL反而出現逆勢強勢：聯茂（6213-TW）一度漲停、騰輝-KY（6672-TW）大漲、台光電（2383-TW）同步走強；23日台光電、欣興也都是盤面強勢股。
這透露一個很重要的訊號：
資金並沒有全面撤離AI，而是在AI供應鏈內部進行輪動。
而且ABF載板也受到法人持續關注。
新光證券9/23盤後資料指出，欣興、景碩、南電近期受AI需求與高階載板供需改善預期帶動；較早的外資研究也指出AI上行循環與ABF/BT載板供給緊張可能支持價格。
下周觀察順序
第一層：台光電、金像電
偏向高階CCL／PCB＋AI伺服器。
第二層：聯茂
24日已經出現強勢表現，因此下周最大的問題不是「有沒有題材」，而是：
漲停後能不能換手，而不是直接爆量長黑。
第三層：欣興、景碩
ABF載板近期已成為市場明顯資金主軸，9/22欣興、景碩、南電甚至同步漲停。
四、第三主軸：散熱——健策、奇鋐
9/23健策直接漲停、收6,410元，市場聚焦AI伺服器散熱與均熱片需求。
但這裡我要特別提醒：
基本面強 ≠ 短線可以追價。
因為散熱族群近期已經累積相當大的漲幅，所以真正要看的，是：
量縮整理 → 再放量突破
而不是：
連續急漲 → 爆大量 → 再追。
則可以與健策一起觀察。
AI伺服器功耗持續提升，散熱從「配件」逐漸變成AI資料中心的重要基礎建設。
因此下周可以觀察：
奇鋐是否接棒健策，形成散熱族群內部輪動。
五、第四主軸：台積電＋AI ASIC
台積電（2330-TW）
這是下周最大的大盤觀察指標。
23日台積電收2,500元，單日對大盤貢獻約317點，占當日指數漲點接近九成。
所以現在最大的問題不是台積電基本面，而是：
台積電如果休息，市場能不能由其他AI族群接棒？
這會直接影響大盤。
另一方面，TSMC最新產業資料顯示，AI需求仍是先進製程主要成長動能，市場對2026年營收與EPS預期在第二季財報後進一步上修；3nm、5nm需求尤其強勁，但2nm初期量產仍處於爬坡階段。
因此下周：
台積電＝指數風向球
而不是單純的個股行情。
聯發科（2454-TW）
這檔我會特別放進下周觀察名單。
9/22聯發科盤中創5,480元歷史新高，資金明顯從台積電轉向IC設計與ASIC相關族群；24日早盤大盤一度重挫時，聯發科仍一度逆勢翻紅。
這代表：
AI ASIC＋IC設計仍有資金承接。
也是ASIC族群值得觀察的代表。
9/22創意漲停並創歷史新高，法人近期也持續關注Google自研CPU與AI ASIC相關需求。
不過創意與信驊等高價股目前共同問題是：
股價反映預期的速度可能比EPS成長速度更快。
因此下周更適合觀察「強勢整理後是否再次放量」，而不是看到突破就立即追價。
六、第五主軸：記憶體
這一塊我會列為下周高彈性、高波動觀察區。
南亞科（2408-TW）
華邦電（2344-TW）
力積電（6770-TW）
近期AI伺服器需求增加，使市場持續關注DRAM供需與報價。
9/23南亞科、華邦電、旺宏、力積電同步出現反彈，其中南亞科盤中一度上漲逾5%；近期亦有外資與本土法人調升南亞科目標價的報導。
而凱基9/15半導體研究也將南亞科、華邦電列入「長短料瓶頸」研究標的。
下周要觀察的是：
DRAM報價 → 毛利率 → EPS → 資本支出
能不能形成完整的獲利循環。
如果只有股價上漲、但後續報價與營收沒有同步，波動就會明顯增加。
七、我會把下周觀察名單分成三組
A組｜大型權值＋基本面

台積電（2330-TW）
台達電（2308-TW）
鴻海（2317-TW）
聯發科（2454-TW）


B組｜AI供應鏈高成長

台光電（2383-TW）
金像電（2368-TW）
聯茂（6213-TW）
欣興（3037-TW）
景碩（3189-TW）
健策（3653-TW）
奇鋐（3017-TW）
貿聯-KY（3665-TW）
緯穎（6669-TW）
創意（3443-TW）


C組｜高彈性題材

南亞科（2408-TW）
華邦電（2344-TW）
旺宏（2337-TW）
力積電（6770-TW）
光通訊／CPO相關族群


這個分類是依產業趨勢與近期盤面強弱整理，不是對個別股票未來報酬的排名。
八、下周最重要的「三個盤面訊號」
① 48,600附近能否有效突破
9/22盤中高點約48,601點，目前是很重要的前高觀察位置。
如果突破：
量能是否同步增加會比「單純突破」更重要。
② 47,800～48,000是否形成短線支撐
24日早盤最低約47,754點，市場已經直接測試48K附近的承接力道。
因此下周：
48K之上 → 高檔震盪
跌破47,800 → 注意短線整理擴大
再失守47K → 需要重新檢查短線多空結構
③ 最重要：AI族群能不能「輪動」
這其實比指數漲跌更重要。
目前已經看到：
台積電 → 聯發科 → ABF → CCL → PCB → 散熱 → 記憶體
資金正在不同AI子族群之間輪動。
24日即使台積電下跌，聯發科、台達電、景碩、台光電、聯茂等仍有部分表現，正是這種輪動的例子。
九、下周需要提防的5大風險
1. 美債殖利率重新突破5%
24日市場受到美國10年期公債殖利率一度突破5.13%的壓力，科技股估值容易受到影響。
這對高本益比AI股尤其重要。
2. 油價／中東地緣政治
油價如果重新大幅上升，可能同時推升：
通膨預期 → 利率 → 殖利率 → 科技股估值壓力
因此下周國際油價仍是外部變數。
3. AI股漲幅過大
這是目前最直接的短線風險。
尤其：
散熱、CCL、PCB、ASIC、高價IC設計
部分個股已經出現短期急漲。
所以「基本面看好」與「短線適合追價」必須分開。
4. 台積電過度集中拉抬指數
23日約九成指數漲點來自台積電，這意味著：
如果台積電休息，而其他族群沒有接棒，指數容易出現比較大的震盪。
5. 中秋連假前後的籌碼變化
下周市場面臨假期因素，短線資金可能降低持股或進行調節。
因此不宜單純用「今天漲停＝下周還會漲」的方式判斷。
十、最後幫你濃縮成「下周作戰地圖」
第一觀察：
CCL／PCB：台光電、金像電、聯茂、欣興、景碩
第二觀察：
AI散熱：健策、奇鋐
第三觀察：
AI權值：台積電、台達電、鴻海、聯發科
第四觀察：
ASIC：聯發科、創意
第五觀察：
記憶體：南亞科、華邦電、旺宏、力積電
而整體策略上，我會把目前市場定義為：
「指數高檔、AI基本面仍強、資金快速輪動、個股分化加劇」的階段。
台灣8月出口創下824億美元、年增41%，AI、半導體與資通訊仍是主要出口動能；同時台灣也正在推進以台積電先進封裝為核心的新產業園區，顯示AI半導體供應鏈的中長期資本支出方向仍在。
所以接下來真正值得盯的，不是「大盤會不會再漲」，而是：
「哪一個AI子族群正在接棒？哪一些公司的營收與EPS能跟上股價？」
這會是下周選股的核心。

items.title: AI還沒漲完！缺貨潮才剛開始 下一波看這裡
items.title_en: AI Hasn't Finished Rising! The Shortage Wave Is Just Starting – Look Here for the Next Move
paras: 中秋節前台股一度失守48,000點，但尾盤重新站回整數關卡，跌勢也明顯收斂，顯示高檔雖有震盪，市場結構仍未遭到破壞。接下來連假期間，台股將面對美股三個交易日的變化，觀察重點仍在中東局勢、油價與美債殖利率。現階段市場真正支撐多頭的核心，並不是單純資金炒作，而是企業獲利、AI投資與經濟成長仍具韌性。只要外部風險沒有再度急遽升溫，第四季行情仍有基本面作為支撐，節後資金回流的方向值得持續追蹤。

產業面來看，AI仍是第四季最重要的主軸，而且焦點正從「有沒有成長」進一步轉向「哪個零組件最缺」。多項關鍵零組件交期明顯拉長，包括ABF約48至56週、HDD約50週、MLCC約32週、DRAM約20週、eSSD約16週，反映AI代理、資料中心與新平台推進下，供應鏈仍存在缺料、缺設備與產能吃緊問題。當供需失衡持續，市場資金自然會往具備技術門檻、產業集中度高，或產能與良率正在突破的族群移動，因此晶圓代工、記憶體、散熱、光通訊、CCL、ABF與PCB，仍是後續值得留意的方向。

個股與次產業選擇上，關鍵不是只看股價強弱，而是辨識成長能否延續。以聯發科為例，瑞銀將目標價上調至7,300元，並大幅上修TPU營收與未來EPS預估，核心邏輯在於市場可能尚未完全反映其AI ASIC與TPU業務的戰略價值。散熱方面，奇鋐與雙鴻持續受惠AI伺服器升級，其中系統整合能力與產品完整度成為重要競爭條件；記憶體則仍受資料中心需求推動，即使市場擔憂中國業者擴產，短期供不應求的結構未必因此快速反轉。這些產業共同特徵，就是需求成長明確、技術升級持續，且供給端短期難以完全跟上。

操作上，第四季不宜只用指數高低判斷多空，更重要的是資金配置與風險控制。即使高度看好單一產業或個股，也不代表應把資金集中在同一檔股票，合理分散仍是面對高檔震盪的基本原則。若節後市場延續強勢，應避免在急漲後盲目追價；若優質標的因大盤震盪拉回，反而可重新檢視基本面與買點。整體而言，AI長線趨勢並未改變，但行情進入高檔後，真正能拉開績效差距的，將不只是「看對方向」，而是能否從產業供需、獲利成長與籌碼結構中，挑出最具延續性的核心標的。
市場最怕的不是利空，而是不知道利空什麼時候結束。
但現在，局勢正在反轉。
國際緊張降溫，油價下來了；升息預期消化後，美債殖利率也開始回落。前面壓著科技股的兩座大山，正在一座一座搬開。
更重要的是，美國對AI的態度不是踩煞車，而是繼續加速往「SI超級智慧」推進。對AI、半導體與相關供應鏈來說，這就是下一階段最重要的長線燃料。
而產業趨勢，我從來不是等漲了才講。
前一波我提前鎖定【散熱四超人】，一路從布局、發動到主升段，現在大波段已經完整走完，強勢標的累積漲幅甚至超過100%。
我真正的強項，就是在市場還沒看懂以前，先看懂下一個產業。
散熱這一班已經開出去，接下來誰會接棒？
我已經把下一波產業方向挑好了。

items.title_en: Trump Hosts Xi at White House State Dinner, Tech Titans Gather: Jensen Huang, Tim Cook, Lisa Su Share a Table While No Chinese CEOs Attend
paras: 美國總統川普周四(24日)在白宮設國宴款待中國國家主席習近平，華爾街與矽谷重量級人物齊聚，凸顯美國科技與金融界的影響力。相較之下，中國代表團則無中國企業主參與，凸顯雙方對這次峰會的期待可能有落差。
從美媒照片與報導來看，習近平與川普同桌，同席者包括輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳與妻子Lori Huang、蘋果(AAPL-US)執行長庫克(Tim Cook)，以及超微(AMD-US)執行長蘇姿丰(Lisa Su)與丈夫Daniel Lin 。值得注意的是，美國目前仍禁止輝達部分先進晶片出口中國。
在美中爭相主導人工智慧(AI)之際，川普本周以罕見的國事訪問規格接待習近平。習近平稍後表示，中美可持續就AI議題對話，並共同防範AI遭到濫用。

國宴嘉賓凸顯科技分量

根據路透整理出的名單，其他受邀科技領袖還包括Meta(META-US)執行長祖克伯(Mark Zuckerberg)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)創辦人貝佐斯(Jeff Bezos)、特斯拉(TSLA-US)和SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長Elon Musk、OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)、微軟(MSFT-US)執行長納德拉(Satya Nadella)、戴爾科技(DELL-US)執行長Michael Dell、美光(MU-US)執行長Sanjay Mehrotra及高通(QCOM-US)執行長Cristiano Amon。
金融界則有花旗(C-US)執行長Jane Fraser、摩根大通(JPM-US)執行長戴蒙(Jamie Dimon)、黑石(BX-US)執行長Stephen Schwarzman、高盛(GS-US)執行長蘇德蘶(David Solomon)，以及萬事達卡(MA-US)執行長Michael Miebach。
政治圈部分，美國財長貝森特(Scott Bessent)、商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)、能源部長萊特(Chris Wright)、美國貿易代表格里爾(Jamieson Greer)，以及聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)和妻子、雅詩蘭黛(Estée Lauder Companies)創辦人孫女珍勞黛(Jane Lauder)也在賓客名單上。

名單中也出現波音(BA-US)執行長、洛克希德馬丁(LMT-US)、通用汽車(GM-US)、埃克森美孚(XOM-US)、輝瑞(PFE-US)等企業執行長，以及LVMH董事長阿諾德(Bernard Arnault)，和美國總統科學與技術顧問委員會成員與Craft Ventures創辦人薩克斯(David Sacks)。川普家族成員伊凡卡(Ivanka Trump)、Eric Trump、Lara Trump及Tiffany Trump也在名單上。

中國代表19人清一色官員與眷屬

相較之下，中國今年稍早為川普舉辦的宴會中，美方貴賓主要與親屬及美中代表團官員同桌。
彭博指出，這次超過130名賓客中，中方代表僅19人，而且清一色是官員與眷屬、沒有中國企業領袖，凸顯兩國對此次峰會的期待可能存在差異。
在峰會前，川普曾形容這場國宴是「城裡最熱門的門票」，形容「每個人都想來」，賓客涵蓋「整個科技界、整個銀行界，以及更多人」。
這場國宴共三道菜，包括黃櫛瓜濃湯、芝麻脆皮鱸魚以及香草乳霜佐蜂蜜冰淇淋，菜單以「美國食材搭配細微中國風味」為特色。白宮表示，開場將以加州史瑞堡酒莊(Schramsberg)「Blanc De Noirs」氣泡酒祝酒，該酒款也曾在1972年美國前總統尼克森訪問北京時供應。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday (the 24th) hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping at a state dinner in the White House, drawing heavyweight figures from Wall Street and Silicon Valley and underscoring the influence of America’s tech and finance sectors. In contrast, the Chinese delegation included no Chinese business owners, highlighting a possible mismatch in expectations for the summit.

Photos and reports from U.S. media show Xi sitting at the same table as Trump, alongside NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang and his wife Lori Huang, Apple (AAPL-US) CEO Tim Cook, and AMD (AMD-US) CEO Lisa Su with her husband Daniel Lin. It is noteworthy that the United States still bans the export of certain advanced NVIDIA chips to China.

As the United States and China race to dominate artificial intelligence (AI), Trump welcomed Xi this week with a rare state‑visit format. Xi later said the two countries can continue dialogue on AI and work together to prevent its misuse.

The guest list highlighted the weight of the tech sector. According to a Reuters‑compiled list, other invited tech leaders included Meta (META‑US) CEO Mark Zuckerberg, Amazon (AMZN‑US) founder Jeff Bezos, Tesla (TSLA‑US) and SpaceX (SPCX‑US) CEO Elon Musk, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Microsoft (MSFT‑US) CEO Satya Nadella, Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) CEO Michael Dell, Micron (MU‑US) CEO Sanjay Mehrotra and Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) CEO Cristiano Amon.

From the finance world, guests included Citigroup (C‑US) CEO Jane Fraser, JPMorgan Chase (JPM‑US) CEO Jamie Dimon, Blackstone (BX‑US) CEO Stephen Schwarzman, Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) CEO David Solomon, and Mastercard (MA‑US) CEO Michael Miebach.

On the political side, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, Energy Secretary Chris Wright, U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer, Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh and his wife Jane Lauder – granddaughter of Estée Lauder Companies founder – were also on the guest list.

The list also featured CEOs of Boeing (BA‑US), Lockheed Martin (LMT‑US), General Motors (GM‑US), Exxon Mobil (XOM‑US), Pfizer (PFE‑US) and LVMH chairman Bernard Arnault, as well as David Sacks, a member of the President’s Science and Technology Advisory Committee and founder of Craft Ventures. Trump family members Ivanka Trump, Eric Trump, Lara Trump and Tiffany Trump were also invited.
China’s 19‑person delegation consisted entirely of officials and their families, with no business leaders among them.
Bloomberg noted that of the more than 130 guests, only 19 were from the Chinese side, all officials or family members, underscoring a possible divergence in what each side expects from the summit.

Before the summit, Trump described the state dinner as “the hottest ticket in town,” saying “everyone wants to come,” and said the guest list spanned “the entire tech sector, the entire banking sector, and beyond.”

The three‑course dinner featured zucchini soup, sesame‑crusted sea bass and herb‑cream‑topped honey ice cream, with a menu described as “American ingredients with subtle Chinese flavors.” The White House said the evening began with a toast of Schramsberg “Blanc De Noirs” sparkling wine, the same wine served when President Nixon visited Beijing in 1972.

items.title: 標普500集中度前所未見 這2檔股票就占逾15%
items.title_en: S&P 500 Concentration Unprecedented as Two Stocks Account for Over 15%
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》周四(24日)報導，蘋果(AAPL-US)與輝達(NVDA-US)真正成為了左右股市走勢的關鍵力量。
Creative Planning總裁Peter Mallouk指出，標普500指數如今的持股集中度前所未有，僅兩檔股票就占據指數超過15%的比重。
這項比例遠高於網路泡沫破裂前夕，微軟(MSFT-US)與奇異(GE-US)合計占標普500指數9.1%的比重。
輝達與蘋果近期股價漲勢強勁，這也有助於解釋兩家公司在標普500指數中的重要性為何持續攀升。
蘋果股價周二觸及345美元，創下這家iPhone製造商股價歷史新高。但在美國10年期公債殖利率走高、整體市場回落之際，蘋果也從高點小幅回落。
自蘋果本月稍早發表iPhone 18及首款摺疊手機Duo後，股價一路強勁上漲，推動今年以來漲幅達25%。
輝達8月底表示，公司下一個會計年度的業務成長率至少可達70%。執行長黃仁勳更表示，如果不是受到供應限制，成長率將超過100%。
這家晶片巨頭股價周四收在每股224.58美元，今年以來已上漲約20%。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported on Thursday (the 24th) that Apple (AAPL-US) and Nvidia (NVDA-US) have truly become the key forces driving market direction.
Peter Mallouk, president of Creative Planning, said the concentration of holdings in the S&P 500 index is unprecedented, with just two stocks making up more than 15% of the index.
That proportion is far higher than the pre‑dot‑com‑bubble era, when Microsoft (MSFT-US) and General Electric (GE-US) together accounted for 9.1% of the S&P 500.
The recent strong price gains in Nvidia and Apple also help explain why the importance of the two companies within the S&P 500 continues to rise.
Apple’s share price hit $345 on Tuesday, a historic high for the iPhone maker, but it slipped slightly from that peak as U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields rose and the broader market retreated.
Since Apple unveiled the iPhone 18 and its first foldable phone, the Duo, earlier this month, the stock has surged, driving a 25% gain year‑to‑date.
Nvidia said at the end of August that its business growth rate for the next fiscal year will be at least 70%, and CEO Jensen Huang added that, absent supply constraints, growth could exceed 100%.
The chip giant’s stock closed Thursday at $224.58 per share, up about 20% so far this year.

items.title: 華府川習會盛大登場！美媒看「排場大突破少」關稅休戰暫延續、台海與AI議題受矚
items.title_en: Washington Trump‑Xi Meeting Unfolds in Grand Style! US Media Says “Big Show, Few Breakthroughs”; Tariff Truce Temporarily Extended, Taiwan Strait and AI Topics Draw Attention
paras: 美國總統川普周四(24日)在白宮迎接中國國家主席習近平，雙方就貿易、人工智慧(AI)及日益升高的美中戰略競爭展開會談，這場盛大的國是訪問受到全球關注，但路透評析會談的實質進展有限，未見重大突破，以下是路透整理出此次會談的幾項重要看點：

1、貿易協議暫延兩個月 關鍵問題留待後續談判

美中貿易休戰本周確定延長，但目前只是短期延長。該協議原定於11月到期，美國財長貝森特(Scott Bessent)表示，延長協議能讓雙方「有更多時間看看能在經濟領域做些什麼」。
值得注意的是，這次延長並未敲定一項持久協議，反而是把關稅、中國採購、稀土供應及科技限制等核心問題留到下一輪談判。
貝森特周三表示，北京已履行先前協議中採購2500萬噸黃豆的要求，但在承諾採購170億美元其他農產品方面進度落後。美國官員也表示，中國稀土供應同樣未達承諾，顯示雙方仍存在重大分歧。
對企業而言，這種結果帶來的是熟悉的不確定性：關稅目前維持在較低水準，但企業仍必須在政策方向持續變動的環境下做決策。

2、國是訪問大排場 川普展現「川普風格」華府

對川普而言，習近平訪問白宮也是展現華府正按其理念改造的機會。
習近平先前在北京安排川普參觀北京天壇，以及很少對外國訪客開放的中南海園林 。川普則以另一種形式的盛大場面回應，包括戴著假髮、身穿三角帽的軍人列隊行進，並在重新設計成類似川普高爾夫球場風格的玫瑰園演奏音樂。
本周三與周四舉行的儀式期間，戰鬥機與轟炸機從上空呼嘯而過，其中一次聲響之大，甚至讓川普明顯受到驚嚇。
白宮記者團受邀採訪兩國領袖時，觀看兩人參觀「海軍陸戰隊一號」直升機，以及重新設計的白宮南草坪。現場還設有印有總統徽章的大型直升機停機坪。
川普接受記者提問時，淡化兩人的政策討論。他談到習近平時這麼說：「他喜歡好的花崗岩。很棒的會面。」

3、習近平談台灣 盼美方「審慎處理」

一如預期，習近平在台灣議題上向川普施壓。根據中國官方媒體報導，習近平表示，中方希望美國「審慎處理台灣問題」。中國官方英文媒體也報導，習近平希望美國反對台灣獨立。
這將比華府長期採用的表述更為強硬。美國長期表態是不「支持」台灣獨立，但目前沒有跡象顯示川普政府打算改變這項措辭。
白宮尚未立即公布雙方針對台灣議題討論的會談紀要。不過，美國官員長期避免明確表態反對台灣獨立。若華府改變相關措辭，將引發外界對美國捍衛台灣決心的疑問，也可能遭到美國國會反對。

4、美中戰略風險仍在、AI發展立場分歧

習近平在與川普會面時並非首次提及「修昔底德陷阱」(Thucydides Trap)，這項學術理論認為，崛起強權與既有強權之間的競爭往往可能走向戰爭。
習近平表示，這項風險「可以克服」，但他再次提及修昔底德陷阱，也凸顯潛在美中軍事衝突仍籠罩在全球兩大經濟體的關係上。
習近平認為，中美雙方都能從合作中獲益，也都會因對抗而受損，並呼籲建立定期軍事對話，以及更強化的危機預防機制。
川普則援引兩國共同歷史，強調雙方合作的可能性。他表示，只要追求共同利益，美中可以完成許多事情，並提到兩國在二戰期間共同對抗日本的戰時同盟。
在人工智慧(AI)方面，兩位領袖展現不同立場。
川普曾表示AI應稱為「超級智慧」(super intelligence，SI)。他周四在社群媒體發文表示，希望AI「維持現狀」，並以美國司法部為依歸而非制定新的監管規範，他還堅稱中國也持相同立場。
不過，習近平周四表示，中國和美國身為AI領域的領先國家，必須管理AI的發展。他說：「我們都有能力，也有責任發展和管理AI，讓AI向善，確保AI發展始終受到人類控制，並服務人民福祉。」
美國AI產業重量級人士預定將出席川普周四晚間為習近平舉行的國宴，包括Alphabet(GOOGL-US)執行長皮查伊(Sundar Pichai)、OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)，以及輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳(Jensen Huang)。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday (the 24th) welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping to the White House, where the two discussed trade, artificial intelligence (AI) and the increasingly intense strategic competition between the United States and China. The high‑profile state visit attracted global attention, but Reuters’ analysis said the substantive progress of the talks was limited and no major breakthroughs were evident. Below are several key take‑aways Reuters compiled from the meeting.

1. Trade agreement extended by two months; key issues left for later negotiations
The U.S.–China trade truce was confirmed this week to be extended, but only on a short‑term basis. The agreement was originally set to expire in November. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the extension gives both sides “more time to see what can be done in the economic arena.”

It is noteworthy that the extension does not lock in a lasting deal; instead, core issues such as tariffs, Chinese procurement, rare‑earth supplies and technology restrictions are being postponed to the next round of talks.

Bessent said on Wednesday that Beijing has fulfilled its earlier commitment to purchase 25 million tonnes of soybeans, but is lagging on the pledged $17 billion purchase of other agricultural products. U.S. officials also noted that China’s rare‑earth supply has not met its commitments, indicating significant remaining disagreements.

For businesses, the result brings a familiar uncertainty: tariffs remain at relatively low levels, but companies still have to make decisions in an environment where policy direction continues to shift.

2. State visit staged with grand spectacle; Trump shows “Trump style” in Washington
For Trump, Xi’s visit to the White House was also an opportunity to showcase Washington’s transformation according to his own vision.

Xi had previously arranged for Trump to tour Beijing’s Temple of Heaven and the rarely opened Zhongnanhai gardens. Trump responded with his own lavish display, including soldiers marching in wigs and triangular hats, and a musical performance in a rose garden redesigned to resemble a Trump‑style golf course.
During the ceremonies on Wednesday and Thursday, fighter jets and bombers roared overhead; on one occasion the noise was so loud that Trump appeared visibly startled.

When the White House press pool was invited to interview the two leaders, they observed the pair touring the “Marine One” helicopter and the newly redesigned South Lawn. A large helicopter landing pad bearing the presidential seal was also on site.
When asked by reporters, Trump downplayed policy discussion between the two. He said of Xi, “He likes good granite. A great meeting.”

3. Xi talks Taiwan, urges the United States to “handle it prudently”
As expected, Xi pressed Trump on the Taiwan issue. According to Chinese state media, Xi said China hopes the United States will “handle the Taiwan issue prudently.” The English‑language Chinese official outlet also reported that Xi wants the United States to oppose Taiwan independence.

That language is tougher than the phrasing Washington has long used. The United States has consistently said it does not “support” Taiwan independence, but there is currently no indication the Trump administration plans to change that wording.

The White House has not yet released a transcript of the discussion on Taiwan. However, U.S. officials have long avoided an explicit stance against Taiwan independence. If Washington were to alter its wording, it could raise doubts about America’s resolve to defend Taiwan and might provoke opposition in Congress.

4. Strategic risk between the U.S. and China remains; AI positions diverge
Xi’s remarks during the meeting also referenced the “Thucydides Trap,” an academic theory that the competition between a rising power and an established one often leads to war.

Xi said the risk “can be overcome,” but his repeated mention of the Thucydides Trap underscored that the specter of a military clash still hangs over the relationship between the world’s two largest economies.

He argued that both China and the United States can benefit from cooperation and would both suffer from confrontation, calling for regular military dialogues and stronger crisis‑prevention mechanisms.

Trump, invoking the shared history of the two nations, stressed the possibility of cooperation. He said that as long as both sides pursue common interests, the U.S. and China can achieve many things, citing the World War II alliance against Japan as an example.
On artificial intelligence (AI), the two leaders displayed differing stances.

Trump has previously said AI should be called “super intelligence” (SI). On Thursday he posted on social media that he hopes AI “maintains the status quo,” relying on the U.S. Department of Justice rather than creating new regulatory rules, and he insisted that China shares the same view.

Xi, however, said on Thursday that as leading AI nations, China and the United States must manage AI development. He stated, “We both have the capability and the responsibility to develop and manage AI, to keep AI aligned with good, to ensure AI remains under human control and serves the welfare of the people.”

Prominent figures from the U.S. AI industry are slated to attend the state dinner Trump will host for Xi on Thursday evening, including Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) CEO Sundar Pichai, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, and NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: 再續前緣！高通與蘋果續簽全球專利授權協議 2027年4月1日生效
items.title_en: Continuation of the Frontline! Qualcomm and Apple Renew Global Patent Licensing Agreement Effective April 1, 2027
paras: 高通週四 (24 日) 宣布，已與蘋果續簽全球專利授權協議，新協議將於 2027 年 4 月 1 日生效。蘋果正逐步降低對高通數據機晶片的依賴，但雙方在專利授權上的合作將繼續。高通未公布新協議的期限及財務條款。
這項消息重點在於專利授權與晶片採購是兩份不同的安排。
高通 2023 年與蘋果簽訂的供貨協議，涵蓋 2024 年至 2026 年推出的智慧手機；此次宣布續簽的則是全球專利授權協議，公告沒有提及延長數據機晶片供應。
蘋果近年推進自研數據機，逐步減少採購高通晶片。高通今年 7 月表示，來自蘋果產品的營收將比原先預期更快下滑，並計畫以資料中心業務成長，抵銷 2027 年流失的蘋果營收。
不過，晶片採購與專利授權是不同的合作。蘋果減少使用高通數據機，不等於兩家公司終止專利授權。
高通宣布，雙方已續簽全球專利授權協議，新協議將於 2027 年 4 月 1 日生效；協議期限與財務條款尚未公布。高通整體專利授權業務在截至 6 月的季度約占總營收 15%。
兩家公司曾因專利授權費及數據機晶片供應爭議對簿公堂，直到 2019 年才達成和解、撤銷全球訴訟。
當時蘋果向高通支付一筆金額未公開的款項，雙方並簽下全球專利授權協議及另一份晶片供應協議。現行專利協議將於 2027 年 3 月 31 日屆滿，新協議隔日接續生效。
高通技術授權業務執行副總裁暨總經理 John Han 週四表示，很高興延續與蘋果的授權協議。
Bernstein 分析師 Stacy Rasgon 指出，高通過去公布蘋果授權協議時曾提供更具體的期限，這次資訊較少，讓他對協議能帶來多久的收入保障仍有疑問。
隨著油價和美債殖利率上升，科技股週四承壓，高通 (QCOM-US) 週四下滑 1.51%，至每股 194.26 美元。蘋果 (AAPL-US) 收低 0.33%，至每股 335.92 美元。
paras_en: Qualcomm announced on Thursday (the 24th) that it has renewed its global patent licensing agreement with Apple, with the new agreement taking effect on April 1, 2027. Apple is gradually reducing its reliance on Qualcomm modem chips, but the two companies will continue their collaboration on patent licensing. Qualcomm did not disclose the term or financial terms of the new agreement.
The key point of this news is that patent licensing and chip procurement are two separate arrangements.

Qualcomm’s 2023 supply agreement with Apple covered smartphones launched from 2024 to 2026; the renewed agreement announced this time is the global patent licensing agreement, and the announcement did not mention an extension of modem chip supply.

Apple has been advancing its own modem development in recent years, gradually cutting back purchases of Qualcomm chips. In July, Qualcomm said revenue from Apple products would decline faster than previously expected and it plans to offset the lost Apple revenue in 2027 with growth in its data‑center business.

However, chip procurement and patent licensing are different forms of cooperation. Apple’s reduced use of Qualcomm modems does not mean the two companies are ending their patent licensing relationship.

Qualcomm said the two parties have renewed the global patent licensing agreement, which will become effective on April 1, 2027; the agreement’s duration and financial terms have not been disclosed. Qualcomm’s overall patent licensing business accounted for about 15% of total revenue in the quarter ended June.
The two companies previously fought in court over patent licensing fees and modem chip supply disputes, reaching a settlement and withdrawing the global lawsuit in 2019.

At that time Apple paid Qualcomm an undisclosed sum, and the parties signed a global patent licensing agreement plus another chip supply agreement. The existing patent agreement expires on March 31, 2027, and the new one takes effect the following day.
John Han, Qualcomm’s executive vice president and general manager of technology licensing, said on Thursday he was pleased to continue the licensing agreement with Apple.

Bernstein analyst Stacy Rasgon noted that Qualcomm previously provided more specific timing when it announced Apple licensing deals; the limited information this time leaves him uncertain about how long the agreement will secure revenue.

With rising oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields, tech stocks were under pressure on Thursday; Qualcomm (QCOM-US) fell 1.51% to $194.26 per share, while Apple (AAPL-US) slipped 0.33% to $335.92 per share.

items.title: 〈財報〉好市多Q4勝預期！低價加油站吸客 關稅退款回饋降價
items.title_en: Costco Q4 Beats Expectations! Low‑Price Gas Stations Attract Shoppers, Tariff Refunds Lead to Price Cuts
paras: 好市多(Costco Wholesale)(COST-US)周四(24日)公布第4季財報，營收與獲利均優於市場預期，同店銷售也強勁成長，原因是持續的通膨壓力促使消費者轉向好市多的低價加油站，並帶動賣場各類商品需求。

Q4(8月30日止)財報關鍵數字 vs 分析師預期


EPS：6.75美元 vs 6.53美元
營收：957.2億美元 vs 948.6億美元
同店銷售：+6.7% vs +6.11%


好市多第4季調整後EPS為6.75美元，若排除一次性關稅退款帶來的每股15美分收益，仍優於LSEG資料顯示分析師預期的6.53美元。
第4季營收較去年同期成長約11%至957.2億美元，高於華爾街預期的948.6億美元。
排除汽油與匯率因素後，季度同店銷售額成長6.7%，也高於分析師預期的6.11%。

低價模式吸引精打細算消費者

好市多提供低價大量的採購模式與折扣燃料服務，在生活成本持續上漲之際，吸引更多消費者上門。
CFRA分析師Arun Sundaram說：「好市多又交出全面強勁的一季，同店銷售成長持續領先大型零售同業，客流量與平均客單價均衡成長。」
汽油業務是推升銷售的重要動能，好市多執行長Ron Vachris表示，今年汽油業務創下「史上最佳表現」。
TD Cowen分析師Oliver Chen指出，好市多加油站通常以低於市場價格的水準販售汽油，由於伊朗戰爭大幅推升燃料價格飆升，這項低價策略進一步吸引對價格敏感的消費者。

關稅退款1.84億美元 轉化為商品降價

好市多財務長Gary Millerchip在財報電話會議中表示，第4季依據《國際緊急經濟權力法》(IEEPA)取得1.84億美元關稅退款之後，把這些資金用來調降商品價格，涵蓋民生必需品、肉類、飲料及部分非食品商品。
消費者的平均購物籃規模也有所增加，因為消費者開始整合購物行程，傾向一次購足更多食品及其他必需品，而不是分多次前往賣場。
好市多周四盤後股價微漲0.2%。該股今年截至周四稍早收盤，股價累計上漲近4%。
paras_en: Costco Wholesale (COST-US) announced its Q4 results on Thursday (the 24th), with revenue and profit both surpassing market expectations and comparable‑store sales showing strong growth. The boost came from continued inflation pressure driving consumers to Costco’s low‑price gas stations, which in turn lifted demand for a wide range of merchandise.

Key Q4 figures (ending August 30) versus analyst forecasts: EPS $6.75 vs $6.53 expected; Revenue $95.72 billion vs $94.86 billion expected; Comparable‑store sales +6.7% vs +6.11% expected. Adjusted EPS for the quarter was $6.75; even after stripping out a one‑time $0.15 per‑share gain from a tariff refund, it still beat the LSEG‑reported analyst consensus of $6.53.
Q4 revenue grew about 11% year‑over‑year to $95.72 billion, topping Wall Street’s forecast of $94.86 billion.
Excluding gasoline and currency effects, comparable‑store sales rose 6.7% for the quarter, also above the analyst estimate of 6.11%.
Low‑price model draws price‑conscious shoppers. Costco’s bulk‑purchase format and discounted fuel service attract more customers as living costs continue to rise.

CFRA analyst Arun Sundaram said, “Costco delivered another comprehensively strong quarter, with comparable‑store sales growth still leading large‑retail peers, and both traffic and average ticket size growing in balance.”
Gasoline sales are a key sales driver; Costco CEO Ron Vachris said this year’s fuel business achieved “the best performance in history.”

TD Cowen analyst Oliver Chen noted that Costco’s gas stations typically sell fuel below market levels, and the sharp price spikes caused by the Iran war have made this low‑price strategy even more appealing to price‑sensitive consumers.

Tariff refund of $184 million turned into lower prices. CFO Gary Millerchip told the earnings call that after receiving a $184 million tariff refund under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) in Q4, Costco used the funds to cut prices on a range of items, including essential goods, meat, beverages and some non‑food products.
The average consumer basket size also grew, as shoppers began consolidating trips and tended to buy more food and other necessities in one go rather than making multiple store visits.
Costco’s stock rose modestly 0.2% in after‑hours trading on Thursday. The share has climbed nearly 4% year‑to‑date as of the early closing on Thursday.

items.title: 星巴克本周關閉北美250家門市 持續推動轉型
items.title_en: Starbucks to Close 250 North American Stores This Week as Transformation Continues
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，咖啡連鎖巨頭星巴克(Starbucks)(SBUX-US)計劃關閉更多無法獲利的門市，執行長Brian Niccol持續推動公司的轉型計畫。
星巴克周四(24日)在官方部落格發布信件並寄送給員工，營運長Mike Grams表示，公司計劃本周關閉美國與加拿大共250家門市，使北美門市總數減少約1%。
Grams在給員工的信中寫道，「我們仔細檢視了北美的咖啡店組合，找出一些我們認為無法持續為顧客與合作夥伴提供理想體驗的門市，或是看不到實現令人滿意的財務表現的途徑。」
就在大約一年前，星巴克也採取了相同措施，將門市數量削減1%。截至上一季，星巴克在北美共有18,371家門市，低於一年前的18,734家。
星巴克在關閉部分門市的同時，也正在重新裝修其他門市。公司周三宣布，將加快咖啡店改造計畫，重新加入座椅，並讓店內恢復更舒適、溫馨的氛圍。星巴克表示，預計在2026會計年度結束前完成至少1,500家門市的「升級」，並在2027會計年度進一步加速。
星巴克也表示，計劃明年在印度設立一座科技中心。
這項消息發布前，星巴克公布強勁的第三季業績，顯示Niccol的轉型計畫正取得進展。
星巴克第三季同店銷售額成長7.9%，高於華爾街預期的5.7%，也高於第二季的6.2%增幅。去年同期，公司第三季整體同店銷售額下滑2%。
William Blair分析師Sharon Zackfia表示，關閉門市可能「略微有利於」同店銷售成長，並維持對星巴克股票的優於大盤評級。
星巴克股價過去一年上漲10%，表現落後標普500指數同期15%的漲幅。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reports that coffee chain giant Starbucks (SBUX-US) plans to close more unprofitable stores, with CEO Brian Niccol continuing to push the company’s transformation plan.

Starbucks posted a letter on its official blog on Thursday (the 24th) and sent it to employees; COO Mike Grams said the company plans to close a total of 250 stores in the United States and Canada this week, reducing the North American store count by about 1%.

In the letter to staff, Grams wrote, “We have carefully reviewed the North American coffee‑shop portfolio and identified some locations that we believe cannot continue to provide an ideal experience for customers and partners, or where we see no path to satisfactory financial performance.”
About a year ago, Starbucks took the same step, cutting its store count by 1%. As of the last quarter, Starbucks had 18,371 stores in North America, down from 18,734 a year earlier.

While closing some stores, Starbucks is also refurbishing others. The company announced on Wednesday that it will accelerate its coffee‑shop renovation program, re‑adding seating and restoring a more comfortable, welcoming atmosphere. Starbucks expects to complete upgrades at at least 1,500 stores by the end of fiscal 2026 and to further accelerate the effort in fiscal 2027.
Starbucks also said it plans to open a technology hub in India next year.
The news came after Starbucks reported strong third‑quarter results, showing that Niccol’s transformation plan is gaining traction.

Third‑quarter comparable store sales grew 7.9%, beating Wall Street’s 5.7% forecast and the 6.2% increase seen in the second quarter. In the same quarter a year ago, overall comparable store sales fell 2%.
William Blair analyst Sharon Zackfia said the store closures could “slightly benefit” comparable‑store sales growth and maintained an out‑performance‑of‑the‑market rating on Starbucks stock.
Starbucks’ share price has risen 10% over the past year, lagging the S&P 500’s 15% gain over the same period.
